raw: cikṣepa me sutaḥ rājan sa gatāsuḥ atha apatat
aham saubha pateḥ senām āyasaiḥ bhujagaiḥ iva
chinnān dṛṣṭvā tu tān bāṇān pradyumnena sa saubha rāj
śakyaḥ śūra sutaḥ hantum api vajrabhṛtā svayam
rūpam pituḥ apaśyam tat śakuneḥ patataḥ yathā
kṣura antam amalam cakram kāla antaka yama upamam
viśrambha ghātakānām tu prayāge śṛṇu yat phalam
evam yogasya samprāpti sthānam parama durlabham
pradiṣṭāni ca deyāni na dadyuḥ bhartṛ śāsanāt
somadattaḥ yuyutsuḥ ca droṇaputraḥ tathā eva ca
paśya māyā prabhāvaḥ ayam īśvareṇa yathā kṛtaḥ
anyathā eva hi manyante puruṣāḥ tāni tāni ca
karmaṇā tena pāpena lipyate nūnam īśvaraḥ
a śaṅkamānaḥ kalyāṇi saḥ amutra ānantyam aśnute
kurvataḥ na artha siddhiḥ me bhavati iti ha bhārata
sneha sveda pūrvakaiḥ vamana ādibhiḥ doṣaḥ yena saḥ
māgha māse gamiṣyanti gaṅgāyām bharata ṛṣabha
dharma kāme pratītasya pratipannāḥ sma bhārata
yasya dharmaḥ hi dharma artham kleśa bhāj na sa paṇḍitaḥ
mitrāṇi tasya naśyanti dharma arthābhyām ca hīyate
sa kṣātram hṛdayam kṛtvā tyaktvā idam śithilam manaḥ
artha tyāgaḥ hi kāryaḥ syāt artham śreyāṃsam icchatā
etat bravīhi naḥ sarvam vistareṇa yathā artha vid
nīlaḥ ca niṣadhaḥ ca eva teṣām hīnāḥ ca ye pare
yojanānām sahasram tu dvīpaḥ ayam dakṣiṇa uttaraḥ
catvāri bhārate varṣe yugāni munayaḥ abruvan
pratyakṣam manyase kālam martyaḥ san kāla bandhanaḥ
tasya mārgāt apākrāman sarva bhūtāni gacchataḥ
akīrtim sarva lokeṣu gaccheyam śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
evam uktaḥ pratyuvāca vṛtrahā pāṇḍu nandanam
yat yat ca kṛtavān anyat pārthaḥ tat akhilam vada
nānā veṣa dharaiḥ hṛṣṭaiḥ bhūtaiḥ anugataḥ tadā
ayam ca puruṣaḥ kaḥ api bāṇān grasati sarvaśas
bhūtāni ca piśācān ca gandharvān atha pannagān
vividhaiḥ ca eva nīvāraiḥ muni bhojyaiḥ narādhipa
na tatra sūryaḥ tapati na virājati candramāḥ
nāmnām sahasreṇa tadā tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam
śṛṇu me vadataḥ brahman yaḥ ayam yat ca asya kāraṇam
katham hi rājā putram svam upekṣeta alpa cetasam
vayam hi saha kṛṣṇena hatvā karṇa mukhān parān
tutoṣa sa janaḥ rājñaḥ tasya a laulyena karmaṇā
hiraṇyasya suvarṇasya yāna yugyasya vāsasām
tam draṣṭum arhasi iti evam punar punar abhāṣata
puṣkareṇa evam uktasya puṇyaślokasya manyunā
bṛṃhaṇam madhuram māṃsam vāta pitta haram guru
vanam pratibhayam ghoram śārdūla mṛga sevitam
kva nu te tāpasāḥ sarve kva tat āśrama maṇḍalam
tatra saṃvartakaḥ nāma saḥ agniḥ pibati tat jalam
sa rājānam upātiṣṭhat bāhukaḥ aham iti bruvan
tṛṇa ākhyam pitta jit darbha kāśa ikṣu śara śālibhiḥ
nāradasya ca kaumāram tat eva ca sukha udayam
sukhāt sukhataraḥ vāsaḥ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
yathā ca aham samānītā sudevena āśu bāndhavān
asmad arthe bhavet vā ayam upāyaḥ cintitaḥ mahān
tvam eva haya tattva jñaḥ kuśalaḥ ca asi bāhuka
svāgatam te manuṣya indra kuśalam te bravīmi aham
hṛdayam vyathitam ca āsīt aśru pūrṇe ca locane
rūpe me saṃśayaḥ tu ekaḥ svayam icchāmi veditum
evam uktaḥ sa hṛṣṭa ātmā sūtaḥ paurāṇika uttamaḥ
vārāṇasyāḥ ca māhātmyam kṣetra māhātmya varṇanam
tathā anyāni ca rudrasya caritāni sahasraśas
tebhyaḥ pradhāna devānām trayam āsīt śiva ātmakam
yaḥ arjunena arjunaḥ tulyaḥ dvi bāhuḥ bahu bāhunā
kṛtam iti eva manye aham prasādāt tava suvrata
sāyam prātar smaret yaḥ tu puṣkarāṇi kṛtāñjaliḥ
yatra brahma ādayaḥ devāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ
caturtha avasthasya yathālabdham vṛttiḥ
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā prāṇān ca utsṛjya bhārata
tapaḥ caranti vipulam bahu varṣa sahasrakam
api duṣkṛta karmāṇam nayanti paramām gatim
athā īdṛś bhairava āpatteḥ bandha praśama kāraṇāt
smṛtiḥ ca suṣuve patnī muneḥ ca aṅgirasaḥ tathā
divyam varṣa sahasram hi śākena kila suvrata
puṇḍarīkam avāpnoti sūrya lokam ca gacchati
kūrma rūpeṇa rāja indra asureṇa durātmanā
sarve tapasvinaḥ tu ete sarve vrata bhṛtaḥ smṛtāḥ
sa tvam sṛja yathākāmam mṛtyu yuktāḥ prajāḥ prabho
ṛṣabham parvatam gatvā pāṇḍyeṣu sura pūjitam
agniṣṭoma śatam vindet gamanāt eva bhārata
brahma lokam vrajet rājan punīte ca kulam naraḥ
idam dharmyam idam puṇyam idam medhyam idam sukham
bhīṣma droṇau atirathau kṛpaḥ drauṇiḥ ca durjayaḥ
te vadanti mahātmānam kṛṣṇam dharmam sanātanam
viparyayaḥ na teṣu asti etat svābhāvikam smṛtam
kim asya para cit tattva āroha viśrānti sūcikāḥ
papraccha āgamane hetum aṭane ca prayojanam
doṣa dhātu malānām tu parimāṇam na vidyate
na tat svāsthyāt ṛte śakyam vaktum anyena hetunā
sva aṅga rūpeṣu bhāveṣu pramātā kathyate patiḥ
tadā eva gantāsmi dṛḍham eṣa me niścayaḥ paraḥ
prāṇaḥ sva deha jaḥ vāyuḥ yamaḥ tasya nirodhanam
mantra vīryasya sarveṣām mantrāṇām prāṇa rūpiṇaḥ
ātmā cittam
mahiṣaiḥ ca varāhaiḥ ca sṛmaraiḥ camaraiḥ api
bhūta kañcukī tadā vimuktaḥ bhūyas pati samaḥ paraḥ
tvac doṣāḥ kuṣṭhāni
tuṣṭuvuḥ vividhaiḥ vākyaiḥ idam ca eva abruvan vacaḥ
patnībhyām sahitaḥ tāta saḥ ati hṛṣṭa manāḥ tadā
na ati dīrgheṇa kālena sāgarāṇām kṣayaḥ mahān
ṣaṣṭiḥ tāni sahasrāṇi putrāṇām amita ojasām
icchet śaktaḥ svayam pātum samudram api na āturaḥ
chedanam tāḍanam bandham saṃsāra parivartanam
aham brahma na ca anyaḥ asmi brahma eva aham na śoka bhāj
pāvana artham nara śreṣṭha puṇyena salilena ha
sā tu nāvya āśramam cakre rāja kārya artha siddhaye
vṛkṣa gulma latā vallī tṛṇa ādyāḥ vāri parvatāḥ
yuga akṣa koṭī te tasya dakṣiṇe syandanasya tu
aṃśaḥ bhagaḥ ca dvau etau kaśyapaḥ ca kratuḥ ca tau
sahāraiḥ taiḥ tribhiḥ cakraiḥ yuktaḥ śuklaiḥ haya uttamaiḥ
hemante abhyasyataḥ toyam uṣṇam ca āyuḥ na hīyate
kim nu taiḥ na kṛtam pāpam yaiḥ bhavān tapasi sthitaḥ
tatra avadhānam cittasya bhūyas bhūyas niveśanam
na kṛṣṇa dharmaḥ caritaḥ bhavāya jantoḥ adharmaḥ ca parābhavāya
evam bala haraṇa bala karaṇa ādiṣu api boddhavyam
deha prāṇa manīṣā ādi samudāyasya janmanaḥ
tatra apaśyat tapaḥ vṛddham vayaḥ vṛddham ca bhārgavam
agnīnām atithīnām ca śuśrūṣuḥ anasūyikā
akṣeṣu mṛgayāyām ca pūrva sṛṣṭam punar punar
vidhāsyāmaḥ vayam tatra tava iṣṭim parama adbhutām
tasya etat devayajanam sthānam āditya varcasaḥ
mad kṛte hi mahābhāgaḥ pacyate naraka agninā
hemante śiśire ca eva himotsargaḥ tribhiḥ punar
saṃvardhanaḥ tu yaḥ raśmiḥ sa yoniḥ lohitasya ca
sravaṇāt tejasaḥ ca eva tena asau savitā smṛtaḥ
kim nu me na agnayaḥ śūdra pratinandanti darśanam
gatavān eva tam kṣudram kāla antaka yama upamam
carantam gahane araṇye mene sa pitaram mṛgam
mayā tu hiṃsitaḥ tātaḥ manyamānena tam mṛgam
samarthaḥ hi aham ekākī karma kartum idam mune
pṛcchāmaḥ tvām vayam sarve bahu mānāt punar punar
tasya eva kṛtyam uddiśya tepatuḥ paramam tapaḥ
dahyamāneṣu lokeṣu taiḥ tribhiḥ dānava agnibhiḥ
atha tān dānavān brahmā tapasā tapana prabhān
pitāmaha vacaḥ śrutvā tadā evam dānavaḥ mayaḥ
tapasā ca eva kaunteya sarve yokṣyāmahe vayam
sarāṃsi saritaḥ ca eva parvatān ca vanāni ca
caṇḍa vātam mahat varṣam prādurāsīt viśām pate
sevyamānā ca śītena jala miśreṇa vāyunā
uvāca ca kuru śreṣṭhaḥ bhīmasenam idam vacaḥ
uvāca bhīmasenam sa pitaram satya vikramaḥ
pāṇḍūnām madhya gaḥ vīraḥ pāṇḍavān api ca apare
rukma rūpya āyasānām ca śataśas atha sahasraśas
sṛṣṭi sthiti laya ākāram turyeṇa eva tad ādinā
śabda prabhavam anvicchan cacāra kadalī vanam
ayam ca mārgaḥ martyānām agamyaḥ kuru nandana
eka vedasya ca ajñānāt vedāḥ te bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ
putrāṇām nāmadheyāni kalatrāṇām tathā eva ca
te yūyam yadi anye ca kratu vidhvaṃsakam haram
matsyaḥ ambhasi iva syūta āsyaḥ katham me adya gamiṣyasi
vāli sugrīvayoḥ bhrātroḥ purā iva kapi siṃhayoḥ
hiraṇya sadṛśaiḥ puṣpaiḥ dāva agni sadṛśaiḥ api
rāja dviṣṭam na kartavyam iti dharma vidaḥ viduḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaḥ ca dharmaputraḥ ca dharma vid
śataśas ca api gandharvāḥ tathā eva apsarasām gaṇāḥ
astam parvata rājānam etam āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ
an ādi nidhanam devam prabhum nārāyaṇam param
pṛthak vyāla mṛgāṇām ca pakṣiṇām ca eva sarvaśas
raudram astram madīyam tvām upasthāsyati pāṇḍava
mad gatāni ca yāni iha sarva astrāṇi kuru udvaha
gatāsavaḥ tathā ca anye pragṛhīta śarāsanāḥ
tam arghyeṇa ca pādyena madhuparkeṇa ca īśvarāḥ
tat cit śakti svarūpeṇa prakṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ mahān
astrāṇām ghora rūpāṇām agneḥ vāyoḥ tathā aśmanām
tvac rasajñā śrutiḥ cakṣuḥ ghrāṇam buddhiḥ ca tad mayāḥ
mama karma ca deva indram mātaliḥ vistareṇa tat
rūpam tejasi śabdaḥ ca sparśaḥ ca eva jale tathā
mayaḥ tu devān parirakṣitāram umā ātmajam deva varam kumāram
avatāra sahasrāṇām nidhānam bījam avyayam
dadarśa tat vanam ramyam deva gandharva sevitam
atha te sampravakṣyāmi līlā dehān hareḥ pṛthak
śuddha sattva mayān śāntān loka prema āspadān śṛṇu
pāda bhraṃśaḥ pādasya āropa viṣaya deśāt anyatra patanam
sneham virecanasya ante dadyāt doṣa ādi apekṣayā
vṛttyā śūdra samaḥ hi eṣa yāvat vede na jāyate
tasmai adāt varam aja ātmaja putra rūpam ānanda bindu payasā ca cakāra tīrtham
tasya tejaḥ harāmi āśu tat hi dṛṣṭi balam mama
sādhakāni sadā puṃsām na jātiḥ na kulam nṛpa
evam uktāḥ kṣaṇam cakruḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saha taiḥ dvijaiḥ
vaikuṇṭha darśanam akārayat aprameyaḥ tasyāḥ pañcama manoḥ samaye prasiddham
teṣām yathā vyādhi balam upayogaḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrān ca durvṛttān ṛdhyataḥ prekṣya sarvaśas
karmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ kartā śubhasya api aśubhasya ca
kva ca karmāṇi tiṣṭhanti jantoḥ pretasya bhārgava
svam ātmānam param ca eva budhyante jñāna cakṣuṣaḥ
śarīre svinna bhūyiṣṭhe svinnam bhavati śoṇitam
śīta varṣa anilaiḥ dagdhe snigdham uṣṇam ca śasyate
te tu dṛṣṭvā eva tam ṛṣim vismayam paramam gatāḥ
bālaḥ tvam asi mūḍhaḥ ca vṛddhaḥ kena api hetunā
ādityaḥ divi deveṣu tamaḥ nudati tejasā
saḥ atapyata tapaḥ ghoram varṣāṇām ayutam tadā
tasya sarvasya samprāptaḥ kālaḥ parama dāruṇaḥ
atra trayāṇām iti sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyānām
mama rūpāṇi atha etāni viddhi tvam dvijasattama
sukha udayāya tat sarvam śreyase ca tava anagha
asmin kali yuge api asti punar kautūhalam mama
yadā candraḥ ca sūryaḥ ca tathā tiṣya bṛhaspatī
bibhemi na indrāt hi yamāt varuṇāt na ca vittapāt
yāga hetunā iti
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṅgamāni tathā eva ca
kirīṭa kaustubha dharam pīta kauśeya vāsasam
bale rūpe ca vīrye ca śame ca na samaḥ asti nau
lokānām anta kṛt kālaḥ kālaḥ anyaḥ kalanā ātmakaḥ
indriyāṇām nigraham ca śāśvatam dvijasattama
tad ṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaḍguṇāḥ divyam varṣam āsuram eva ca
na muhyet artha kṛcchreṣu na ca dharmam parityajet
na loke rājate mūrkhaḥ kevala ātma praśaṃsayā
ācāra pālanam ca eva dvitīyam śiṣṭa lakṣaṇam
ācāraḥ ca satām dharmaḥ santaḥ ca ācāra lakṣaṇāḥ
budha śīghrasya śūnya ṛtu kha adri tri aṅka naga indavaḥ
jīvaiḥ grastam idam sarvam ākāśam pṛthivī tathā
teṣām api guṇāḥ sarve guṇa vṛttiḥ parasparam
śabdaḥ sparśaḥ ca rūpam ca rasaḥ ca api dvijottama
rāśibhiḥ sahitāḥ śuddhāḥ ṣaṣṭyā syuḥ vijaya ādayaḥ
asmin kṛta yugasya ante sarve madhya gatāḥ grahāḥ
vṛddhau ūcatuḥ
yat daivatebhyaḥ kartavyam tat etābhyām karomi aham
tava śokena vṛddhau tau andhau jātau tapasvinau
mātā pitroḥ ca śuśrūṣām kariṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ
vaḍavāmukhaḥ pibati ambhaḥ yaḥ asau parama dāruṇaḥ
agniḥ āgrayaṇaḥ nāma bhānoḥ eva anvayaḥ tu saḥ
caturbhiḥ sahitaḥ putraiḥ bhānoḥ eva anvayaḥ tu saḥ
atharvāṇam tathā ca api havyavāhaḥ abravīt vacaḥ
na ca rogaḥ jarā mṛtyuḥ deva deham prapadyate
rakṣobhiḥ ca piśācaiḥ ca raudraiḥ bhūta gaṇaiḥ tathā
gṛhītam tu dhanuḥ tena vipulam loma harṣaṇam
viśvāmitraḥ tu prathamam kumāram śaraṇam gataḥ
śiva śakti samāyogāt ekāntam bhuvi bhāvayet
yadi satyam idam vākyam niścayāt bhāṣitam tvayā
dānavānām vināśāya devānām artha siddhaye
kālam tu imam param skanda brahmaṇā saha cintaya
megha tūrya ravāḥ ca eva kṣubdha udadhi sama svanāḥ
papāta bhinne śirasi mahiṣaḥ tyakta jīvitaḥ
brahma datta varaḥ skanda tvayā ayam mahiṣaḥ hataḥ
etat te prathamam deva khyātam karma bhaviṣyati
vaśa gāḥ ca bhaviṣyanti surāḥ tava sura ātmaja
tathā aśanaiḥ cārubhiḥ agrya mālyaiḥ dākṣiṇya yogaiḥ vividhaiḥ ca gandhaiḥ
tvam iva eṣām su bhadrā ca prītyā sarva ātmanā sthitā
balena abhibhavanti ete tena dānava mānavān
kṛtāḥ kara pradāḥ sarve rājānaḥ te narādhipa
na tu abhyanujñām lapsyāmi gamane yatra pāṇḍavāḥ
manyate abhyadhikān ca api tapaḥ yogena pāṇḍavān
parikrānteṣu laghuṣu adhvaryu puruṣeṣu ca
bhajyamāneṣu anīkeṣu dhārtarāṣṭreṣu sarvaśas
utpatti pralayau ca eva vidyā avidye gata āgatī
iti duryodhana amātyāḥ krośantaḥ rāja gṛddhinaḥ
sama sthaḥ viṣama sthān hi draṣṭum icchati durmatiḥ
evam bruvāṇam kaunteyam bhīmasenam amarṣaṇam
tathā eva śara varṣeṇa gandharvāḥ te bala utkaṭāḥ
sa hatvā sarvaśas ca eva rājānaḥ śūdra yonayaḥ
naṣṭe śrauta smṛte dharme kāma krodha vaśa anugāḥ
evam kṣayam gamiṣyanti hi alpa śiṣṭāḥ prajāḥ tadā
vicāraṇāt tu nirvedaḥ sāmya avasthā ātmanā tathā
tasmāt prāyam upāsiṣye na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum
tatra śocasi rāja indra viparītam idam tava
akārṣīḥ sāhasam idam kasmāt prāya upaveśanam
yuga mātram tu jīvanti nyūnam tat syāt dvayena ca
paśūnām pakṣiṇām ca eva sthāvarāṇām ca sarvaśas
dravya stotram guṇa stotram karma stotram tathā eva ca
kārya kāraṇa bhāvena tathā tasya pravartate
ṣaṣṭhaḥ tu mitrāvaruṇaḥ sattamaḥ kuṇḍinaḥ tathā
na duṣkarataram dānāt tasmāt dānam matam mama
ke guṇāḥ tatra vasatām kim tapaḥ kaḥ ca niścayaḥ
satām sapta padam mitram āhuḥ santaḥ kula ucitāḥ
na sukhe sukha kāmāḥ ca deva devāḥ sanātanāḥ
na ca anyat kriyate karma mūla chedena bhujyate
yugme tu gamyāt bāhujyā koṭijyā tu gatāt bhavet
karma bhūmiḥ iyam brahman phala bhūmiḥ asau matā
gata gamya antara abhyastam vibhajet tattva locanaiḥ
asmad vākyena yaḥ muktaḥ viddhi tam mṛtam eva ca
ṛśyān rurūn śambarān ca gavayān ca mṛgān bahūn
atṛpyan tatra vīrāṇām hatānām māṃsa śoṇitaiḥ
bhīma arjunau api śrutvā krośa mātra gatam ripum
eṣā sphuṭa gatiḥ proktā sūrya ādīnām kha cāriṇām
vibhīṣaṇaḥ tu rūpeṇa sarvebhyaḥ abhyadhikaḥ abhavat
abhiṣekāya rāmasya yauvarājyena bhārata
iti evam uktaḥ mārīcaḥ kṛtvā udakam atha ātmanaḥ
sarva indriyāṇām sarva īśe viṣṇau gatiḥ anuttamā
etasmin antare rakṣaḥ rāvaṇaḥ pratyadṛśyata
tayoḥ śaśaṃsa gṛdhraḥ tu sītā arthe rāvaṇāt vadham
sameṣu mitra bhāvena dīneṣu dayayā tathā
tasyām antar sarva sukham adhikam vā api labhyate
alam tava vināśāya rāma vīrya vyapāśrayāt
na tu anyam abhigaccheyam pumāṃsam rāghavāt ṛte
sa tasyāḥ tanu madhyāyāḥ samīpe rajanīcaraḥ
tvayā ca plavaga śreṣṭha tat bhuṅkte pavanātmajaḥ
api rājyam ayodhyāyām kārayiṣyāmi aham punar
dṛṣṭavantaḥ sma tatra eva bhavanam divyam antarā
sīte rāmasya dūtaḥ aham vānaraḥ mārutātmajaḥ
śrūyate tumulaḥ śabdaḥ tatra tatra pradhāvatām
babandha rāvaṇiḥ bhūyas śaraiḥ datta varaiḥ tadā
sevā paraḥ dveṣa hīnaḥ janeṣu sa ca sattamaḥ
prītyā viṣṇu jana dveṣa hīnaḥ prākṛtaḥ ucyate
rāma kīrtyā samam putra jīvitam te bhaviṣyati
divyāḥ tvām upabhogāḥ ca mad prasāda kṛtāḥ sadā
deva gandharva yakṣāṇām mānuṣa asura bhoginām
kāryā prītiḥ tava hareḥ yathā bhaktiḥ na naśyati
bhakteṣu prīti karaṇam janānām mukti kāraṇam
yamaḥ tena prahāreṇa susrāva rudhiram mukhāt
mene yama sahasrāṇi sṛṣṭāni yama māyayā
matvā surān svakān eva jaghne ghora astra lāghavāt
strīṇām tathā eva māsena bhavet ārtava sambhavaḥ
yadi dharme ca te buddhiḥ mām ced jīvantam icchasi
gṛhītvā paraśum bhartuḥ sakāśam punar āgamat
tat sarvam ānupūrvyeṇa śaśaṃsa asmai vṛṣaḥ tadā
ādeśe tava tiṣṭhantī hitam kuryām narottama
vasan prāpsyati te gehe satyam etat bravīmi te
tvayi dharmaḥ yaśaḥ ca eva kīrtiḥ āyuḥ ca dehinām
varmaṇā kuṇḍalābhyām ca śaktim me dehi vāsava
nakulaḥ sahadevaḥ ca bībhatsuḥ ca aparājitaḥ
yakṣaḥ aham asmi bhadram te na asmi pakṣī jalecaraḥ
sarasi ekena pādena tiṣṭhantam aparājitam
tebhyaḥ ayam kuru vaṃśaḥ ca yadūnām bharatasya ca
dīkṣā āyatana vijñāna dveṣiṇaḥ ye tu cetasā
śiṣyaḥ vyāsasya dharma ātmā sarva veda vidām varaḥ
āsan praveśe pārthānām tat adbhutam iva abhavat
yadā aśrauṣam śukra sūryau ca yuktau kaunteyānām anulomau jayāya
tūṣṇīm caturtham
ucitam pūjanam tatra devānām api durlabham
na anarthakam
brahmaṇaḥ āsanam brahmāsanam
śrāntaḥ asi atha muhūrtam tvam raṇāt apasṛtaḥ bhava
itareṣām tu sva śāstra samaya upanyasta anuṣṭhānam eva śreyaḥ tat alam anena
duryodhanasya bhīmasya dina ardham abhavat tayoḥ
ambā upākhyānam api ca parva jñeyam atas param
mokṣaḥ nārāyaṇa astrasya parva anantaram ucyate
śuka praśna abhigamanam brahma praśna anuśāsanam
vana sthān pāṇḍavān hantum mantraḥ duryodhanasya ca
tam duṣṭa bhāvam vijñāya vyāsasya āgamanam drutam
pāñcālānām ca sarveṣām saubha ākhyānam tathā eva ca
vana vāsa gatānām ca pāṇḍavānām mahātmanām
tathā indra vijayam ca api yānam ca eva purodhasaḥ
kuryāt atandritaḥ yogī pratyāhāram tu pañcamam
śveta abhiṣekaḥ kṛṣṇa uktaḥ vicitraḥ bahu vistaraḥ
samavāye ca yuddhasya rāmasya āgamanam smṛtam
adhyāyānām śatam ca atra ṣaṭcatvāriṃśat eva ca
atrā adhyāyāḥ trayaḥ proktāḥ ślokānām ca śatam tathā
tathā eva adya iha magnānām bhava viṣṇo sura āśrayaḥ
aja īśaḥ śāsanaḥ śāstā śaṃbhuḥ caṇḍaḥ dhruvaḥ tathā
tasya arakṣat padam savyam mārutaḥ amita vikramaḥ
tena astreṇa tat astram ca babhraṃśe tad anantaram
raṇa āgāram iva udgāram tatyāja asura nandanaḥ
khaḍgena rākṣasa indrasya nicakarta ca vāhanam
saḥ asurasya apatat mūrdhni daityaḥ tam ca na buddhavān
ṛtu kṣetra ambu bījānām sāmagryāt aṅkuraḥ yathā
yathā payasi sarpiḥ tu gūḍhaḥ ca ikṣau rasaḥ yathā
atha agni śaraṇe apaśyat jvalitam jātavedasam
tasya brahman ruroḥ sarvam caritam bhūri tejasaḥ
etasmin eva kāle tu menakāyām prajajñivān
utsṛjya ca eva tam garbham nadyāḥ tīre jagāma ha
hanyām sadā eva bhujagam yam yam paśyeyam iti uta
ātmānam eva atha jaghanya kārī śastreṇa yaḥ hanti hi karma kurvan
sāmānyam etat lakṣaṇam uktam
mṛduḥ śītaḥ anukūlaḥ ca sugandhiḥ ca anilaḥ śubhaḥ
śiva śiva
nāgānām ālayam ramyam uttamam saritām patim
jagmatuḥ parama prīte param pāram mahodadheḥ
ākaram sarva ratnānām ālayam varuṇasya ca
sa śrutvā atha ātmanaḥ deham suparṇaḥ prekṣya ca svayam
yathā aham abhijānīyām brāhmaṇam lakṣaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ
svam svam praharaṇam teṣām parasparam upādravat
tayoḥ ekaḥ api yam paśyet sa tūrṇam bhasmasāt bhavet
īśaḥ aham api sarvasya kariṣyāmi tu te arthitām
vidyāt
nimeṣa unmeṣa kālena samam mātrā tu sā smṛtā
tvayā tu idam vacaḥ kāryam mad niyogāt prajā hitam
heyā iti yadi vaḥ buddhiḥ tava api ca tathā prabho
hitaḥ hi ayam sadā asmākam priya kārī ca nāga rāj
namaḥ astu te bhīma gaṇa anugāya namaḥ astu nānā bhuvana ādi kartre
na etat alpam aham manye kāraṇam loka sundari
āstām tad dharma sadbhāva saṃbodhaḥ tāvat adbhutaḥ
nāma eva paramam jāpyam nāma eva prārthanam param
atas aham tvām prabravīmi śāpaḥ asya na bhavet yathā
tatra rakṣām kuruṣva iti punar punar atha abravīt
na rājānam gamiṣyāmi kim tena nṛpa sūnunā
bāndhavānām hitasya iha yathā ca ātma kulam tathā
pragṛhya araṇyam agamat samīpam tasya pannagaḥ
ruruḥ uvāca
sukham asmi uṣitaḥ bhadre brūyāḥ tvam bhrātaram śubhe
asti iti udaram uddiśya mama idam gatavān ca saḥ
viṣṇau ca devatā sāmyam anya uddeśa nivedanam
ete aparādhāḥ dvātriṃśat viṣṇoḥ nāmnām atha śṛṇu
prakāśa kṣama tā svāsthyam viśadam laghu locanam
tapasvinam atīva atha tam muni pravaram nṛpa
aparādha śatam tasya kṣamate svasya keśavaḥ
śṛṇu rājan yathā asmākam yena etat kathitam purā
sa tu tena eva vṛkṣeṇa bhasmībhūtaḥ abhavat tadā
sthapatiḥ buddhi sampannaḥ vāstu vidyā viśāradaḥ
janamejayasya ke tu āsan ṛtvijaḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ
uttaṅkaḥ hi abhavat tatra netā ca brāhmaṇa uttamaḥ
gṛhāśramī viṣṇu bhaktaḥ kuryāt kṛṣṇam dhiyā smaran
daśa śīrṣāḥ śata śīrṣāḥ tathā anye bahu śīrṣakāḥ
nacirāt iva vidvāṃsaḥ vede dhanuṣi ca abhavan
bhajanasya alpa mātreṇa bahu manyeta yaḥ sadā
svarga sthaḥ jīva lokasya yathā śakraḥ sukha āvahaḥ
anyeṣām kṣatriyāṇām ca bhūri draviṇa tejasām
viṣṇu bhakta prasaṅgasya nimeṣeṇa api nārada
iha satkāra yogaḥ ca bhārate parama ṛṣiṇā
yadi ekam api yaḥ dadyāt tena sarvam kṛtam bhavet
mad avajñā pāpa haram nāmnām sahasram uttamam
vasuḥ
bīja kṣetra samāyoge sasyam jāyeta laukikam
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāt jajñe dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ janeśvaraḥ
kravyādeṣu ca bhūteṣu gajeṣu ca mṛgeṣu ca
jagāma śaraṇam devam sarva bhūta pitāmaham
na tān balasthān bālye api jaghnuḥ bharata sattama
kadrūḥ ca manuja vyāghra dakṣa kanyā eva bhārata
viśvāvasuḥ ca bhānuḥ ca sucandraḥ daśamaḥ tathā
bhujagānām suparṇānām rudrāṇām marutām tathā
bṛhaspatiḥ utathyaḥ ca saṃvartaḥ ca dhṛta vratāḥ
teṣām putra sahasrāṇi babhūvuḥ bhṛgu vistaraḥ
sa jajñe mānuṣe loke śiśupālaḥ nara ṛṣabhaḥ
ajījanat sutam ca asyām sarva śastrabhṛtām varam
aṃśāvataraṇam samyak gandharva apsarasām tathā
kārya stambham sureśāna śoṣaṇam pūraṇam tathā
kāśyapam sthīyatām atra yāvat āgamanam mama
cara tasya tapaḥ vighnam kuru me priyam uttamam
bhavet ca me manmathaḥ tatra kārye sahāya bhūtaḥ tava deva prasādāt
abruvan śakunāḥ sarve kalam madhura bhāṣiṇaḥ
ātmanaḥ bandhuḥ ātmā eva gatiḥ ātmā eva ca ātmanaḥ
yamasya ca yathā daṇḍam kuberasya gadā yathā
api ca tvām nayiṣyāmi nagaram svam śuci smite
tam kumāram ṛṣiḥ dṛṣṭvā karma ca asya ati mānuṣam
tasmin kāle sva rājya sthaḥ mām anusmara paurava
aham śuśrūṣaṇa paraḥ pāda mūle vasāmi vaḥ
athā anyat sampravakṣyāmi śatroḥ uccāṭanam varam
na abhijānāmi kalyāṇi tvayā saha samāgamam
putreṇa lokān jayati putreṇa ānantyam aśnute
devānām api kā śaktiḥ kartum saṃbhavam ātmanaḥ
na bharethāḥ katham nu tvam dharma jñaḥ san svam ātmajam
vedeṣu api vadanti imam mantra vādam dvijātayaḥ
tvad aṅgebhyaḥ prasūtaḥ ayam puruṣāt puruṣaḥ aparaḥ
āvayoḥ antaram paśya meru sarṣapayoḥ iva
tathā parivadan anyān tuṣṭaḥ bhavati durjanaḥ
amukte hi prayoktavyam sarvam jana śatam haret
bharatāt bhāratī kīrtiḥ yena idam bhāratam kulam
babhūvuḥ brahma kalpāḥ ca bahavaḥ rāja sattamāḥ
kacaḥ tu tam tathā iti uktvā pratijagrāha tat vratam
vibhītakasya tailena sarvān ekatra kārayet
sukham asmi uṣitaḥ bhadre na manyuḥ vidyate mama
vaseyam iha tasmāt te tyajāmi viṣayam nṛpa
caturṇām api varṇānām vivāham brāhmaṇaḥ arhati
bala rūpa anta karaṇīm buddhi prāṇa vināśinīm
tasmāt prajā samucchedam turvaso tava yāsyati
jarā doṣaḥ tvayā uktaḥ ayam tasmāt tvam na abhipadyase
prīti yuktaḥ nṛpa śreṣṭhaḥ cacāra viṣayān priyān
yadā sa paśyate kālam dharma ātmā tam mahīpatiḥ
yaḥ putraḥ guṇa sampannaḥ mātā pitroḥ hitaḥ sadā
vara dānena śukrasya na śakyam vaktum uttaram
aṣṭakaḥ
vasumanāḥ
guhyam artham māmakebhyaḥ bravīmi mātāmahaḥ aham bhavatām prakāśaḥ
śatroḥ horā rāśiḥ tad adhipatiḥ janma bham tad īśaḥ vā
yadi ca ādareṇa pṛcchati daivajñaḥ nirdiśet vijayam
ṛkṣāt saṃvaraṇaḥ jajñe rājan vaṃśa karaḥ tava
sūrya dine dhana nāśaḥ cāndre śakti kṣayaḥ anna hāniḥ ca
niyamaiḥ sarva varṇānām brahma uttaram avartata
sita pakṣa ādau candre śubhe śubham pakṣam aśubham aśubhe ca
evam teṣām aham samyak śaptānām rāja sattama
vadhaḥ paśu varāhāṇām tathā eva mṛga pakṣiṇām
asaṃśayam tvam evā ekaḥ śatāt api varaḥ sutaḥ
sūtaḥ
adhiroha ratham mātar gacchāvaḥ sva gṛhān iti
tat yuddham āsīt tumulam ghoram devāsura upamam
tvaramāṇaḥ tvarā kāle kṣatriya ṛṣabha sattamaḥ
yajñasenaḥ
ye piṣṭvā lepam kurvanti teṣām śuci kā api patati na muñcati
yadi praśna cintāyām pṛthivī tattva akṣarāṇi bhavanti tadā pṛthvī tattvam bhavati
yadā cittam bhavati kṛtasya vākya viṣaye pṛthivī viṣaye tadā salila tattva akṣarāṇi bhavanti tadā sa japtam japati
bhogaḥ arthaḥ sarva tattvānām saḥ api karma nibandhanaḥ
mama api prasavaḥ jātaḥ tad kṣaṇāt eva bhārata
kāmam kāma anubandham ca viparītān pṛthak pṛthak
tat idam dharma yuktam ca hitam ca eva kulasya naḥ
guṇaiḥ samuditam samyak idam naḥ prathitam kulam
śikhi pattra nakha varṇena likhet
evam mayā śrutam
anukampyaḥ asi yakṣa indra sugatānām mama api ca
iti tṛtīya upāyaḥ
kulam ca te adya dhakṣyāmi krodha dīptena cakṣuṣā
pañca malena svarṇakāraḥ bhavati
śabda eka grāhakam śrotram sparśa eka grāhiṇī ca tvac
pāṇḍum nara varam raṅge hṛdayena ākulā abhavat
katham hi śudhyate tarkaḥ kasmāt tarkaḥ pravartate
katham dṛśyam vibhāvaḥ katham katham bhūmiṣu vartate
akaniṣṭhe kimartham tu vīta rāgeṣu budhyase
atha anyat sampravakṣyāmi auṣadham parama durlabham
bhāṣiṣye aham te
tatra idam ucyate
anyān ca suhṛdaḥ rājan kurūn sarvān tathā eva ca
vākyasya etasya nidhane dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata
iti putra śatam rājan yuyutsuḥ ca śata adhikaḥ
pacet ṣoḍaśa yāmān ca manda madhya haṭha agninā
mūla patra phalam bilvāt śāka vṛkṣāt ca tat trayam
kāṅkṣamāṇaḥ aham āsiṣye dehasya asya samāpanāt
vāhanāni ca mukhyāni śastrāṇi kavacāni ca
tasmin dṛṣṭe phale tāta prayatnam kartum arhasi
apatyam dharma phala dam śreṣṭham vindanti sādhavaḥ
sadṛśāt śreyasaḥ vā tvam viddhi apatyam yaśasvini
tasmāt na jātu ruṣṭasya narma spṛṣṭaḥ janaḥ kila
api atra gāthām gāyanti ye purāṇa vidaḥ janāḥ
prasādam kuru me rājan itas tūrṇam nayasva mām
svāgatena ca pādyena mṛdu vākyaiḥ ca bhārata
na kariṣyati tasyāḥ ca bhaviṣyati etat eva hi
punar bheda sahasram ca tāsām eva tu vistaraḥ
etāsām pāragaḥ yaḥ ca sa ca uktaḥ vedapāragaḥ
ādi kalpe punar ca eva bhidyante sādhubhiḥ punar
samṛddha yaśasam kuntī suṣāva samaye sutam
mārutam marutām śreṣṭham sarva prāṇibhiḥ īḍitam
dadarśa giri śṛṅga stham vyāghram vyāghra parākramaḥ
eṣa madrān vaśe kṛtvā kurūn ca saha kekayaiḥ
dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ca eva gandharva apsarasaḥ tathā
ājagāma āśrama padam saṃpadām āśrayam tadā
evam bhava tvam bhūyas ca bhartṛ deha ardha dhāriṇī
cakruḥ uccāvacam karma yaśasaḥ arthāya duṣkaram
tasmāt te bhavitā apatyam anurūpam asaṃśayam
pāṇḍuḥ śāpa bhayāt bhītaḥ śataśṛṅgam upeyivān
athā gatya sadā tasmai mantram añjanam uttamam
vāñchitam manasaḥ tasmai mantra jñāya na saṃśayaḥ
āvābhyām tu eva sahitaḥ gamiṣyasi viśām pate
uttamāni uttama aṅgāni yadi evam tu bhaviṣyati
tasyāḥ tasya ca yat kāryam kriyatām tat anantaram
eteṣām bharaṇam bhīṣma mahān dharmaḥ tathā eva ca
kṛtakṛtyam iva ātmānam manyate puruṣa adhamaḥ
prāṇaḥ apānaḥ samānaḥ ca udānaḥ vyānau ca vāyavaḥ
prāṇa apāna samākṣiptaḥ tathā jīvaḥ na tiṣṭhati
ājagāma gṛhān eva mama putrau iti bruvan
bandhanāya ca mūḍhānām yoginām mokṣa dā smṛtā
dṛṣṭam te pauruṣam śakra raṇeṣu śataśas mayā
tvam eva paramaḥ rājā sarve ca kuravaḥ tava
pāṇḍavān dhārtarāṣṭrān ca droṇaḥ mudita mānasaḥ
astre ca paramam yogam priyaḥ droṇasya ca abhavat
yasyāḥ mātrāsu tiṣṭhanti tat param jyotiḥ om iti
arjunaḥ jayatām śreṣṭhaḥ
pratyabhāṣata durdharṣaḥ pāṇḍavānām ratha ṛṣabham
tad vākya sama kālam tu bībhatsuḥ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
kṛtāstrān dhārtarāṣṭrān ca pāṇḍu putrān ca bhārata
anujyeṣṭham ca te tatra yudhiṣṭhira purogamāḥ
sukumāram ca sūkṣmam ca gurum ca api guru priyaḥ
kaḥ ayam iti āgata kṣobhaḥ kautūhala paraḥ abhavat
raṅgaḥ ayam sarva sāmānyaḥ kim atra tava phalguna
guroḥ samakṣam yāvat te harāmi adya śiraḥ śaraiḥ
asya rājya pradānasya sadṛśam kim dadāni te
prītaḥ asmi tava bhaktasya tapasā anena suvrata
labdha mātre vare ca atha sarvāḥ saḥ abādhata prajāḥ
bhīṣmeṇa sahitāḥ sarve yayuḥ svam svam niveśanam
atha samāne kāla udayaḥ
teṣām duryodhanaḥ śrutvā tāni vākyāni bhārata
sahasra aṃśena tat siddham divyam bhavati kāṃcanam
evam ukteṣu rājñā tu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu
sa tvam rāsabha yuktena syandanena āśu gāminā
evam vāra trayam kuryāt tāram bhavati śobhanam
yāma dvādaśa paryantam bhāṇḍa pṛṣṭhe dṛḍha agninā
rūḍha mūlaḥ bhavet rājye dhārtarāṣṭraḥ janeśvaraḥ
iti vyavasitam pārtha dhārtarāṣṭrasya me śrutam
ahirbudhnyaḥ aṣṭamūrtiḥ ca gajāriḥ ca mahānaṭaḥ
vināśe pāṇḍu putrāṇām kṛtaḥ mati viniścayaḥ
tatra aham api ca jñātvā tasya pāpasya niścayam
atas kaṣṭataram kim nu draṣṭavyam hi bhaviṣyati
te jīvanti sukham loke bhavanti ca nirāmayāḥ
dharma ātmā pāṇḍava śreṣṭhaḥ pāpa ācāra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
dṛṣṭvā eva bhīmasenam sā śāla skandham iva udgatam
tad dravam tāmra pātra stham abhiṣekam viduḥ budhāḥ
tām viditvā cira gatām hiḍimbaḥ rākṣasa īśvaraḥ
tadā śilāḥ ca kuñjān ca vṛkṣān kaṇṭakinaḥ tathā
tayoḥ yuddhena rāja indra tat vanam bhīma rakṣasoḥ
tat sarvam jāyate svarṇam deva ābharaṇam uttamam
bhujayoḥ antaram prāptaḥ bhīmasenasya rākṣasaḥ
karomi tava sāhāyyam śīghram eva nihanyatām
punar eva arjunaḥ vākyam uvāca idam vṛkodaram
tvam kurūṇām kule jātaḥ sākṣāt bhīma samaḥ hi asi
na ca aśitaḥ asau bhavati kalyāṇa anna bhṛtaḥ purā
tathā ardha bhāgam bhīmasya bhikṣā annasya nṛpa uttama
tat ca tatra kṛtam karma tava api iha sukha āvaham
arthaḥ ca tava dharmaḥ ca bhūyān atra pradṛśyate
utsṛjya api ca mām ārya vetsyasi anyām api striyam
etat sarvam samīkṣya tvam ātmatyāgam ca garhitam
bhojanam puruṣaḥ ca ekaḥ pradeyam vetanam mayā
tat bhūtam adhibhūtam ca tat param parama ṛṣīṇām
sarva tulyam punar sūtam dattvā tatra eva mardayet
tadā satyam ca śaucam ca dharmaḥ ca eva vivardhate
tad vāpena dravet sattvam lohāni sakalāni ca
iṃdragopaḥ aśva lālā ca śaśa maṇḍūkayoḥ vasā
bhīmasenaḥ
ahasat bhīmasenaḥ atha rākṣasam bhīma darśanam
tam tu vāmena pādena kruddhaḥ bhīma parākramaḥ
tayoḥ vegena mahatā tatra bhūmiḥ akampata
kim āścaryam itas loke kālaḥ hi duratikramaḥ
hiṃsatām hi vadhaḥ śīghram evam eva bhavet iti
tat sarvam jāyate svarṇam śrute śabde na saṃśayaḥ
katham drupada putrasya dhṛṣṭadyumnasya pāvakāt
yayoḥ eva samam vittam yayoḥ eva samam śrutam
atas prayatitam rājye yajñasena mayā tava
uvāca astra vidām śreṣṭhaḥ droṇam brāhmaṇa sattamam
svapiti ekārṇave ca eva yat āścaryam abhūt purā
tathā eva sakhyam bībhatso cirāya bharata ṛṣabha
sarveṣām eva bhāvānām rūpeṇa eva samaḥ kramaḥ
kaḥ hi vaḥ triṣu lokeṣu na veda bharata ṛṣabha
evam tām sa mahīpālaḥ babhāṣe na tu sā tadā
yatamānaḥ yatiḥ sādhuḥ smṛtaḥ yogasya sādhanāt
vijñeyam śravaṇāt śrautam smaraṇāt smārtam ucyate
dṛṣṭvā anurūpam artham yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ na evā api gūhati
brahma viṣṇu sura indrāṇām tathā anyeṣām api sthitiḥ
śata vāram prayatnena tat tāmram kāṃcanam bhavet
ātma dhyāyī mita āhārī yāvat dvādaśa vatsaram
āśrayāḥ puṇya śīlānām sarva kāma phala pradāḥ
yāni padmasya parṇāni bhūrīṇi tu narādhipa
bhojanam ahitam vidyāt punar asya uṣṇīkṛtam rūkṣam
vavande devam īśānam sarva īśam sarva gam prabhum
namaḥ astu sarva bhūtānām īśāna vṛṣavāhana
namaḥ vikaraṇāya eva kāla varṇāya varṇine
vasiṣṭham gautamam ca eva bhṛgum aṅgirasam manum
vidvān bhavatu vaḥ vipraḥ dharma kāma artha tattva vid
bhojanīyāni peyāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca
evam uktaḥ tadā pārtha viśvāmitraḥ balāt iva
yoni deśāt ca yavanān śakṛt deśāt śakān tathā
vivāda śamana artham hi prabodha artham ca bhāsvaram
liṅgasya dakṣiṇe bhāge tadā apaśyat sanātanam
īśānam īśa mukuṭam puruṣa āsyam purātanam
tasya bhāvam viditvā sa nṛpateḥ kuru nandana
saḥ agacchat parvatān ca eva saritaḥ ca sarāṃsi ca
tvat ṛte adya mahābhāga sarva veda vidām vara
ekasyām ca galitāyām dvitīyām kṣipet
kṛtam tena purā sarvam vaktum arhasi pṛcchataḥ
śāpam prāptaḥ asi durdharṣa na pāpam kartum arhasi
daitya rakṣaḥ gaṇa grāham yakṣa uraga jhaṣa ākulam
uvāca devatāḥ sarvāḥ sapratijñam idam vacaḥ
suvarṇa ābhā śarīra kāntiḥ bhavati
bhasma digdha śarīrāya bhānu soma agni hetave
śaṅkhapālāya śaṅkhāya rajase tamase namaḥ
mahādevāya devānām īśvarāya namaḥ namaḥ
buddhi vīrya bala utsāhaiḥ yuktān devān iva aparān
ghrāṇa jena ca vātena kampyamānam tvayā saha
pradhānam avyayaḥ yoniḥ avyaktam prakṛtiḥ tamaḥ
sanakaḥ sanātanaḥ ca eva tathā eva ca sanandanaḥ
kalpe śeṣāṇi bhūtāni sūkṣmāṇi pārthivāni ca
punar ārambha vaiyarthyam evam ca akarmakaḥ sati
ete vetsyanti vikrāntāḥ tvad artham lakṣyam uttamam
mānī dṛḍha astraḥ sampannaḥ sarvaiḥ ca nṛpa lakṣaṇaiḥ
anye haya gatāḥ tatra gaja skandha gatāḥ pare
madhye ca asya rathaḥ sarva pakṣi pravara haṃsaḥ
sapta dhātu gataḥ lokān trīn dadhāra cacāra ca
namaḥ nadīnām prabhave nadānām prabhave namaḥ
vidyānām prabhave ca eva vidyā adhipataye namaḥ
namaḥ pāśāya śastrāya namaḥ tu ābharaṇāya ca
kāma dāya variṣṭhāya kāma aṅga dahanāya ca
sarvam mama kṛtam deva parituṣṭaḥ asi me yadi
sarva loka mayam devam dṛṣṭvā stutvā pitāmahaḥ
jagataḥ trāsa jananam yuga saṃvartaka upamam
tatra sattva sahasrāṇām sāgara antara cāriṇām
rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ nāma krośantīm mukta mūrdhajām
tasya āśrama pada abhyāśe vavuḥ vātāḥ sugandhinaḥ
tīvra svedaḥ ca khedaḥ ca bhayam ca āsīt tadā āvayoḥ
navatim yojanānām tu gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
balam buddhiḥ ca tejaḥ ca sattvam ca hari sattama
sthāsyāmaḥ ca eka pādena yāvat āgamanam tava
nānā gandharva mithunaiḥ pāna saṃsarga karkaśaiḥ
sarvathā kṛta kāryaḥ aham eṣyāmi saha sītayā
prasthitam dīrgham adhvānam sva bandhum iva bāndhavāḥ
kṛte ca pratikartavyam eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
dhṛtiḥ dṛṣṭiḥ matiḥ dākṣyam sa karmasu na sīdati
sāgaram sāgara anūpān sāgara anūpa jān drumān
kṛtam hi tat syāt sukṛtam mama idam yaśaḥ ca puṇyam ca hitam tat etat
vada kalyāṇi bhadram te yathā tvam manasā icchasi
anvicchan paramam brahma tyāga dharma paraḥ abhavat
bhaviṣyanti mama ekasyāḥ patayaḥ tat bravīhi me
anya deha antare ca tvam rūpa bhāgya guṇa anvitā
abhivṛṣṭaḥ sthitaḥ tatra babhau puṣpa mayaḥ yathā
na dānasya na bhedasya na eva yuddhasya dṛśyate
śṛṇu guhyatamam ca anyat rahasyam deva nirmitam
ebhiḥ māsa prayogam ca bhaga lepanam uttamam
rakṣitam rākṣasaiḥ bhīmaiḥ siṃhaiḥ iva mahat vanam
dṛśyaiḥ ca parama udāraiḥ taiḥ taiḥ ca mṛga pakṣibhiḥ
yā ca rājñaḥ kuberasya yamasya varuṇasya ca
pāṇim gṛhāṇa prathamam tvam asyāḥ
pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṃyogam gatasya drupadasya tu
tāni āpnuhi tvam kalyāṇi sukhinī śaradām śatam
yaḥ asau atyakramīt yuddhe yudhyan duryodhanam tadā
brahma rūpa dharān śrutvā pāṇḍu rāja sutān tadā
kuśalam pāṇḍavāḥ sarvān āhuḥ sma andhaka vṛṣṇayaḥ
bhavet sadyas pravaktā ca śruti smṛti dharaḥ api ca
tāsām candra upamaiḥ vaktraiḥ śubhaiḥ lalita kuṇḍalaiḥ
rūpa saṃlāpa śīlena yukta gīta artha bhāṣiṇā
na hi me para dārāṇām dṛṣṭiḥ viṣaya vartinī
putram ca sūtaputram ca dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ abravīt idam
rādheya manyase tvam ca yat prāptam tat bravīhi me
yatiṣyante na rājyāya sa hi teṣām vyapāśrayaḥ
paruṣam dāruṇam krūram tīkṣṇam indriya tāpanam
mātā pitroḥ vināśena sugrīva vyasanena ca
namaḥ astu rudra indra yama anilebhyaḥ namaḥ astu candra arka marut gaṇebhyaḥ
hitam tu paramam karṇa bravīmi kuru vardhanam
kārtavīrya arjunaḥ nāma rājā bāhu sahasra bhṛt
dadarśa pāṇḍavān tatra vāsudevam ca bhārata
yat yat bhāvayate rūpam tad tad rūpa dharaḥ bhavet
nava pala upayogena sura melāpakaḥ bhavet
kaṭu amla tīkṣṇa lavaṇam picchilam pittalam ca yat
bhīmasena arjunau ca eva yamau ca puruṣa ṛṣabhau
tena tiṣṭhantu nagare pāṇḍavāḥ śaradām śatam
gaccha tvam adyā eva nṛpa kṛtakṛtyaḥ asi kaurava
jaya iti brāhmaṇa giraḥ śrūyante ca sahasraśas
pauravāṇām adhipatiḥ kuntī putraḥ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
kṛta maṅgala saṃskāram praviveśa gṛha uttamam
sarvān bhogān parityajya bhartṛ sneha balāt kṛtā
aśru sampāta paryantam ācāryaiḥ trāṭakam smṛtam
śayānau toya madhye tu varṣā kāle yudhiṣṭhira
na sa tam rākṣasaḥ kāmam śaśāka ātmani gūhitum
śuṣyantīm rudatīm ekām dhyāna śoka parāyaṇām
svadharme rakṣasām bhīru sarvathā eṣa na saṃśayaḥ
kulam samprāptayā puṇyam kule mahati jātayā
paruṣāṇi hi vākyāni yāni yāni bravīṣi mām
apohya rāmam kasmāt hi dāra cauryam tvayā kṛtam
pratiloma anulomaiḥ ca sāma dāna ādi bhedanaiḥ
jagmuḥ viṣādam tat karma dṛṣṭvā sunda upasundayoḥ
alam aśru prapātena tyaja śokam anarthakam
na hi me jīvitena arthaḥ na evā arthaiḥ na ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ
varāheṇa daśagrīvaḥ śiṃśumāreṇa ca indrajit
jahāra sarva bhūtānām cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca
cakāra maṇḍalam tatra vibudhānām pradakṣiṇam
nirdahet api kākutsthaḥ kruddhaḥ tīvreṇa cakṣuṣā
vana vāsam gamiṣyāmi samayaḥ hi eṣa naḥ kṛtaḥ
rakṣitā svasya vṛttasya sva janasya api rakṣitā
kuśalī tava kākutsthaḥ sarva śastrabhṛtām varaḥ
mukham drakṣyasi rāmasya pūrṇa candram iva uditam
puṇyāni ca eva tīrthāni dadarśa bharata ṛṣabha
kṛtam vaḥ tatra dharma artham atra dharmaḥ na duṣyati
śaraṇam ca prapannā asmi tvām adya puruṣottama
evam uktaḥ tu kaunteyaḥ pannaga īśvara kanyayā
ānupūrvyeṇa tīrthāni dṛṣṭavān kurusattamaḥ
jagāma tāni tīrthāni draṣṭum puruṣa sattamaḥ
mām nayet yadi kākutsthaḥ tat tasya sadṛśam bhavet
iha eva tāvat kṛta niścayaḥ hi aham yadi vrajeyam plavaga īśvara ālayam
nanṛtuḥ nartakāḥ ca eva jaguḥ gānāni gāyanāḥ
gāndharveṇa vivāhena rāgāt putra artha kāraṇāt
nāgān aśvān tathā eva ca
yūyam eva asya jānīta yaḥ ayam yat vā kariṣyati
na dhanuḥ na rathaḥ na aśvāḥ tatra adṛśyanta na iṣavaḥ
yuyutsuḥ anyaiḥ punar eva rākṣasaiḥ tat eva vīraḥ abhijagāma toraṇam
keśavasya vacaḥ tathyam manyamānāḥ tu yādavāḥ
paryaṅkāṇām sahasram ca dadau kanyādhanam tadā
pāṇḍavaḥ api ca dharma ātmā
ratnāni ādāya śubhrāṇi dattāni kuru sattamaiḥ
rākṣasa indreṇa saṃvādaḥ tasmāt gṛhṇantu mām pare
hanyatām dahyatām vā api bhakṣyatām iti ca apare
bhrājamāna aṅgadaiḥ pīnaiḥ pañca śīrṣaiḥ iva uragaiḥ
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahastaḥ vākyam abravīt
saḥ abravīt arjunam ca eva vāsudevam ca sātvatam
agni vāyu ravibhyaḥ tu trayam brahma sanātanam
sa yuvābhyām sahāyābhyām astra vidbhyām samāgataḥ
tasya nā anyā bhavat buddhiḥ divase divase nṛpa
sṛṣṭim sasarja ca eva imām sraṣṭum icchan imāḥ prajāḥ
evam uktaḥ tu rudreṇa śvetakiḥ manuja adhipaḥ
prīyamāṇaḥ rathe tasmin abhavat kṛṣṇasārathiḥ
rāghavasya vyalīkam yaḥ kṛtvā sukham avāpnuyāt
ubhayam api ca ubhaya ātmakam
samīraṇaḥ mātariśvā pavanaḥ ca sadāgatiḥ
sa punar śākhā ākhyaḥ
tān abravīt ṛṣīn sarvān prīta ātmā śrūyatām iti
yadi mām vṛtta sampannām tad samāgama lālasām
kampamānaiḥ ca śikharaiḥ patadbhiḥ api ca drumaiḥ
evam bruvantīm śārṅgāḥ te pratyūcuḥ atha mātaram
evam sapta puṭaiḥ mṛtyum loha cūrṇam avāpnuyāt
kṛtabuddhiṣu kartāraḥ kartṛṣu brahma vedinaḥ
hanyāt striyam mūḍhagarbhe yathā uktāḥ ca api upadravāḥ
pāṇḍu danta nakhaḥ yaḥ ca pāṇḍu netraḥ ca mānavaḥ
madhyamaḥ katamaḥ putraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ katamaḥ ca te
apadhyānena sā tena dhūma aruṇa sama prabhā
mayasya tu kathām divyām śrotum icchāmi sattama
sa prākāram avaplutya paśyāmi bahu pādapam
aham ca śiṃśapā vṛkṣe pakṣī iva gahane sthitaḥ
naṣṭa ojasam raṇe kṛtvā param harṣam upāgamam
mayaḥ
tayoḥ eva antaram giryoḥ āryāvartam viduḥ budhāḥ
asurān mānuṣān devān gandharvān rākṣasān api
mālya japya namaskāraiḥ gandhaiḥ uccāvacaiḥ api
vaidikaiḥ karmabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ niṣeka ādiḥ dvijanmanām
bhāga ekam iti
yatra iṣṭam munibhiḥ sarvaiḥ nārada ādyaiḥ mumukṣubhiḥ
tatra gatvā sa jagrāha gadām śaṅkham ca bhārata
te śilāḥ pādapān ca api pāṣāṇān ca api vānarāḥ
vana pālam punar vākyam sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata
tāram bhasma prajāyate
tathā tvam api sugrīvaḥ nā anyaḥ tu hari sattama
abravīt tān hari śreṣṭhaḥ vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
kim śeṣam gamanam tatra sugrīvaḥ yatra me guruḥ
tatra saṃyoga apekṣī loka śabdaḥ
tasya hetuḥ utpattiḥ vṛddhiḥ upaplavaḥ viyogaḥ ca
prakṛti bhūtānām tu khalu vāta ādīnām phalam ārogyam
sūkṣmāṇi tāmra patrāṇi iti
mahatsu ca upaviṣṭeṣu gandharveṣu ca bhārata
viṣa yogāḥ ca te sarve viditāḥ śatru nāśanāḥ
tat sarvam śrotum icchāmi yadi snehaḥ asti mā prati
tvad darśana kṛta utsāhau laṅkām bhasmīkariṣyataḥ
sugrīvaḥ sattva sampannaḥ tava arthe kṛta niścayaḥ
punar punar iti
atha nāga utpatti bheda vivaraṇam
teṣām karmasu bāhyeṣu yogam ābhyantareṣu ca
saṃyogam ca prayogam ca yaḥ veda sa bhiṣaj varaḥ
āhāra mātrā punar agni bala apekṣiṇī
ahiṃsayā eva bhūtānām kāryam śreyaḥ anuśāsanam
saṃyoge ca viyoge ca teṣām karma eva kāraṇam
kuryāt tad anurāgeṇa tam āhuḥ puruṣottamam
pattram dalam chadaḥ parṇam palāśaḥ chadanam tathā
sarvathā su kṛtam tāvat sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam
capalam mṛdulam snigdham drutadrāvaḥ ca gauravam
grantha antarāt vaṅgeśvaraḥ
iti vaṅga śodhanam
iti vaṅga kalpaḥ
etat śarīra tattvam uktam
dyūtam ca janavādam ca parivādam tathā anṛtam
anūpaḥ bahu doṣaḥ ca samaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ mataḥ
yathā ca upadiśanti āptāḥ pratyakṣam gṛhyate yathā
pitta ādhikye ca capalā kaṭuka ādeḥ ca bhakṣaṇāt
sthitvā sthitvā calantī yā sā smṛtā prāṇa nāśinī
na kuryāt guru putrasya pādayoḥ ca avanejanam
evam uktaḥ pāṇḍavena nāradaḥ pratyuvāca tam
iti kṣīra viśodhanāni
rātrim divam śarīram me dahyate madana agninā
teṣām trayāṇām śuśrūṣā paramam tapaḥ ucyate
te eva hi trayaḥ vedāḥ te eva uktāḥ trayaḥ agnayaḥ
arthaḥ dharmaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca vidyutaḥ ca api pāṇḍava
aparājitaḥ ca doṣaḥ ca nandakaḥ pūraṇaḥ tathā
aham ekaḥ haniṣyāmi rāghavam sahalakṣmaṇam
pitā ca tu āha kaunteya pāṇḍuḥ kaurava nandanaḥ
doṣa hīnaḥ ati rūkṣaḥ ca sutarām capalaḥ priye
rākṣasam kṣatriyasya ekam āsuram vaiśya śūdrayoḥ
tasya samrāj guṇa arhasya bhavataḥ kuru nandana
icchayā anyonya saṃyogaḥ kanyāyāḥ ca varasya ca
sāmarthya yogam samprekṣya deśa kālau vyaya āgamau
dūtaḥ
muram ca narakam ca eva śāsti yaḥ yavana adhipau
punar niveśanam tasyām kṛtavantaḥ vayam nṛpa
yotsyate sa bala amarṣī divya astra bala garvitaḥ
mama ca api antarātmā ayam śuddham vetti vibhīṣaṇam
ṛṣeḥ kaṇvasya putreṇa kaṇḍunā parama ṛṣiṇā
yasya mṛtyoḥ iva krodhaḥ śakrasya iva parākramaḥ
evam koṭi sahasreṇa śaṅkūnām ca śatena ca
samīpa stham ca rāmasya bhrātaram svam vibhīṣaṇam
kim nu mṛtyoḥ bhayam nā asti mām vaktum paruṣam vacaḥ
japaḥ a hutaḥ hutaḥ homaḥ prahutaḥ bhautikaḥ baliḥ
sumukhaḥ durmukhaḥ ca atra vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ
avasthām paścimām bhartuḥ kṛpaṇā sādhu paśyatu
vaiśvadevasya siddhasya gṛhye agnau vidhi pūrvakam
saṃbhramaḥ rakṣasām eṣa tumulaḥ loma harṣaṇaḥ
viśvebhyaḥ ca eva devebhyaḥ balim ākāśe utkṣipet
udvignā śaṅkitā ca asmi na ca svastham manaḥ mama
adharmaḥ rakṣasām pakṣaḥ hi asurāṇām ca rāvaṇa
para pakṣam praviśya eva na etat śrotra gatam mama
sarvam sukṛtam ādatte brāhmaṇaḥ anarcitaḥ vasan
ekaḥ hi kurute pāpam kāla pāśa vaśam gataḥ
ete ca anye ca bahavaḥ vānarāḥ śīghra gāminaḥ
na ādatte ghaṭa śabdaḥ ambhaḥ candra śabdaḥ na rājate
iti evam tu vadan vīraḥ lakṣmaṇam lakṣmaṇa agrajaḥ
rāvaṇaḥ tu param cakre krodham prāsāda dharṣaṇāt
etasmin antare teṣām anyonyam abhidhāvatām
a śrotriyaḥ vā putraḥ syāt pitā syāt vedapāragaḥ
jyāyāṃsam anayoḥ vidyāt yasya syāt śrotriyaḥ pitā
astraiḥ astrāṇi yaḥ hanyāt śakrasya api mahātmanaḥ
vasudhāyām imau suptau dṛśyete śalyakau iva
ye stena patita klībāḥ ye ca nāstika vṛttayaḥ
avedanānām śuddhānām gambhīrāṇām tathā eva ca
pakṣiṇām poṣakaḥ yaḥ ca yuddha ācāryaḥ tathā eva ca
yaḥ alpa auṣadha kṛtaḥ yogaḥ bahu grantha bhayāt mayā
hiṃsraḥ vṛṣala vṛttiḥ ca gaṇānām ca eva yājakaḥ
vraṇa kriyāsu evam āsu vyāsena uktāsu api kriyām
anyonyam pādapaiḥ ghoraiḥ nighnatām śūla mudgaraiḥ
saḥ abravīt ucyatām kāmaḥ jagatsu pravaraḥ api yaḥ
śabda mātreṇa tantrasya kevalasya eka deśikāḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu karma śatrūṇām sārathim vākyam abravīt
veda artha vid pravaktā ca brahmacārī sahasra daḥ
na tu ariṣṭasya jātasya nāśaḥ asti maraṇāt ṛte
daitya dānava yakṣāṇām gandharva uraga rakṣasām
varṇe svare ca gandhe ca rase ca uktam pṛthak pṛthak
sarvam tat khalu me mogham yat taptam paramam tapaḥ
dhriyamāṇe tu pitari pūrveṣām eva nirvapet
mudgaraiḥ musalaiḥ ca eva sarva prāṇa samudyataiḥ
tathā iti uktvā tu te sarve punar āgamya rākṣasāḥ
bhrātuḥ sa bhavanam gacchan rakṣaḥ bala samanvitaḥ
samānām ca anubandhaḥ syāt iti artham kriyate kriyā
anyeṣām rākṣasa indrāṇām vara dāna kṛtam balam
rākṣasānām sahasraiḥ ca vṛtaḥ parama durjayaḥ
īṣat tu parivṛttābhyām netrābhyām vākyam abravīt
yadi śakraḥ yadi yamaḥ yadi pāvaka mārutau
tat uktam atikāyasya balinaḥ bāhu śālinaḥ
sarva ābharaṇa naddha aṅgaḥ śūla pāṇiḥ sa rākṣasaḥ
evam tasya bruvāṇasya kumbhakarṇasya rākṣasāḥ
tat vānara anīkam ati pracaṇḍam diśaḥ dravat bhinnam iva abhra jālam
mattaḥ śoṇita gandhena svān parān ca eva khādati
paśya me mudgaram ghoram sarva kālāyasam mahat
doṣa dhātu agni samatām saṃprāptim viṣayeṣu ca
idānīm khalu aham na asmi yasya me patitaḥ bhujaḥ
sarve astra viduṣaḥ vīrāḥ sarve yuddha viśāradāḥ
prapitāmahān tathā ādityān śrutiḥ eṣā sanātanī
eka vāsāḥ
kāmarūpi tvam
kṣiprāṇi viddha mātrāṇi ghnanti kāla antareṇa ca
karoti anyān guṇān ca api svāḥ sirāḥ pavanaḥ caran
a bhītaḥ
tatra śāstram tantram granthaḥ vidyā ca
sa ca anya viśiṣṭaḥ ayam śiṣyaḥ iti
tathā hi purastāt iha eva munīnām indraḥ vakṣyati
ucyate anaiśvaryam bandhaḥ
prahāra pīḍanābhyām tu yat aṅgam pṛthu tām gatam
atra ātma īśvara saṃyogaḥ yogaḥ
vyāyāmam ca na seveta bhagnaḥ rūkṣa annam eva ca
vyākhyānam eteṣām vistara vibhāga viśeṣa upasaṃhāra nigamanāni
vyāyāmam maithunam kopam uṣṇa amla lavaṇa aśanam
nirbhidyamānaḥ sahasā sahamānaḥ ca tān śarān
nikumbha agraja vīryam te bāṇa vegam tat adbhutam
kumbhakarṇaḥ tu vīryeṇa sahate ca sura asurān
sa tatra abhihataḥ tena sugrīvaḥ vānara ṛṣabhaḥ
yavāḥ kulatthāḥ kolāni katakasya phalāni ca
idam idānīm cintyam
viśeṣa arthī ca ayam brāhmaṇaḥ
bhakṣyaḥ kṣīra anupānaḥ vā pitta śleṣma āturaiḥ naraiḥ
patitāyām śilāyām tu rakṣasām vyathitā camūḥ
jaghāna rudatīm sītām indrajit rāvaṇa ātmajaḥ
na ca evam yat utpādāt pūrvam saṃbhavaḥ syāt
yajanāt ca āyatanam
eṣa tam nara śārdūlaḥ rāvaṇim niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
āha kasya nirmālyam dhāryam
sṛṣṭi anantaram eva īśaḥ śivān sṛṣṭvā dṛśā ātmajān
ekādaśa śatam ca eva vatsarān uṣitam ghṛtam
gauḍāni rasa śuktāni madhu śuktāni yāni ca
jīmūta kalkam cūrṇam vā pibet śītena vāriṇā
sarṣapāṇām madhūkānām toyena lavaṇasya vā
sa punar sva śiṣyebhyaḥ prāha iti purastāt sarvam spaṣṭīkariṣyāmaḥ
caturṇām api ca eteṣām dvijānām gṛhamedhinām
kāla aśva yukte mahati sthitaḥ kāla antaka upamaḥ
vastiḥ īṣat paṭu yutaḥ paramam bala śukra kṛt
pradakṣiṇāni kurvīta prajñātān ca vanaspatīn
kaṭu pāki uṣṇa vīryam ca śoṣaṇam chedanam tathā
sarpiḥ madhu yutam pītam tat eva khadira ambunā
vraṇa bhāva gatāyām vā kṛtvā saṃśodhana kriyām
sarvaḥ pitta haraḥ kāryaḥ vidhiḥ madhura śītalaḥ
pāda prakṣālanam pāda mala roga śrama apaham
śarkarā madhu sarpirbhiḥ yuktam līḍhvā payaḥ pibet
adhārmikam taskaram ca parasya eva ca yoṣitam
virecana atiyogena samānam tasya lakṣaṇam
japatām juhvatām ca eva vinipātaḥ na vidyate
anvāsanam ca snehena śodhanīyena śasyate
eka dvi tri guṇaḥ samyak āhārasya kramaḥ tu ayam
lāghavam śirasaḥ yoge sukha svapna prabodhanam
lāghavam śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ srotasām vyādhi nirjayaḥ
indriyāṇām prasādaḥ ca kavale śuddhi lakṣaṇam
parīkṣita strī puruṣam bhavet ca api mahānasam
vega antare tu anyatame kṛte karmaṇi śītalām
prājñaḥ pratigraham kuryāt avasīdan api kṣudhā
ye bakavratinaḥ viprāḥ ye ca mārjāraliṅginaḥ
kupyet svayam viṣam yasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ
vāyu agni ambu prakṛtayaḥ kīṭāḥ tu vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ
stambhaḥ śvāsaḥ tamaḥ vṛddhiḥ tālu śoṣaḥ ca jāyate
sarveṣām eva dānānām brahma dānam viśiṣyate
tasmāt alpa antara guṇāḥ kramaśas śālayaḥ avarāḥ
yaḥ na kṛṣṇaḥ na tāmraḥ ca kuraṅgaḥ saḥ abhidhīyate
uttamān uttamān eva gacchan hīnān tu varjayan
sauvīram badaram snigdham madhuram vāta pitta jit
kaṣāya madhuraḥ majjā kolānām pitta nāśanaḥ
kaṭu uṣṇam rocanam hṛdyam vṛṣyam ca eva ārdrakam smṛtam
ekākī cintayānaḥ hi param śreyaḥ adhigacchati
tāla nārikela kharjūra prabhṛtīnām mastaka majjānaḥ
atas sarva anupānāni upadekṣyāmaḥ
kāle api sātmyam laghu ca api bhuktam annam na pākam bhajate narasya
bhavet abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca mokṣaḥ tat ca na yujyate
tayoḥ abhāvaḥ hi ekatra prakāśa tamasoḥ iva
atha māraṇe puṭa praśaṃsā
atha vyādhi bhedena puṭān āha
loha cūrṇāni sarvāṇi dhātavaḥ lavaṇāni ca
purāṇa sarpiḥ timireṣu sarvaśas hitam bhavet āyasa bhājana sthitam
tatra upanāham bhrū madhye kuryāt ca uṣṇa ājya secanam
yuktau kṛtau dāha śopha ruj harṣa srāva nāśanau
sādhāraṇam api jñeyam evam ropaṇa lakṣaṇam
vāta vyādhiṣu yaḥ ca uktaḥ vidhiḥ sa ca hitaḥ bhavet
katham mṛtyuḥ prabhavati veda śāstra vidām prabho
kaparda bhāra ruciram manda hāsa ānanam śivam
strī kṣīram ca eva varjyāni sarva śuktāni ca eva hi
kravyādān śakunān sarvān tathā grāma nivāsinaḥ
namaḥ śaktiḥ iti khyātam rahasyam mantram uttamam
devāya vastra yugalam upavīta dvayam tathā
rasasya smaraṇam puṇyam darśanam sparśanam tathā
yat puṇyam rasaliṅgasya pūjayā tat phalam bhavet
guruḥ kumbha jalaiḥ kuryāt prokṣaṇam pañcapallavaiḥ
atha ādau svedanam karma dvitīyam mardanam priye
aśuddhāḥ bāndhavāḥ sarve sūtake ca tathā ucyate
kuryāt evam hi sūtasya mukham bhavati śobhanam
yathā uktena eva kalpena śudhyanti tu sanābhayaḥ
svarṇam dvādaśa bhāgam syāt tad ardham śuddha pāradam
nirudhya ca dhamet tīvram evam kuryāt punar punar
prete rājani sa jyotiḥ yasya syāt viṣaye sthitaḥ
yāvat svarṇa avaśeṣam syāt svarṇa bījam idam priye
tāvat svarṇa avaśeṣam syāt svarṇa bījam idam priye
dhamet svarṇa avaśeṣam syāt hema bījam idam priye
na rājñām agha doṣaḥ asti vratinām na ca sattriṇām
śiva loke sukham bhuṅkte tāvat kalpa sahasrakam
pūti bījam idam sūta garbhe dravati tad kṣaṇāt
soma agni arka anila indrāṇām vitta appatyoḥ yamasya ca
jvaraḥ aparaḥ sambhavati taiḥ taiḥ anyaiḥ ca hetubhiḥ
asya abhyāsāt ghṛtasya iha jīvet varṣa śata trayam
pratyakṣa buddhiḥ svapna ādau yathā sā ca yadā tadā
māsena kāntiḥ medhā ca bhavati eva na saṃśayaḥ
yaḥ dharmaḥ ekapatnīnām kāṅkṣantī tam anuttamam
takra bhaktam ca sauvīram tikta kaṭu amla lāvaṇam
yasya saṃsparśa mātreṇa sarva lohāni kāñcanam
idam dolāyantram
muni annaiḥ vividhaiḥ medhyaiḥ śāka mūla phalena vā
atha māraṇam
anyat ca sugamam
svādhyāye nitya yuktaḥ syāt dāntaḥ maitraḥ samāhitaḥ
etaiḥ śloka ardha nirdiṣṭaiḥ kvāthāḥ syuḥ pitta pācanāḥ
vidyut prabhām deha dārḍhyam svaccham snigdham ca lekhanam
saptame divya dṛṣṭiḥ syāt aṣṭame viṣa nāśanam
etāni yati pātrāṇi manuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ abravīt
doṣāḥ ca asya yathā
tathā ca vāgbhaṭaḥ
kṣāravarge pacet ca anyat pacet mūtra gaṇe aparam
adhiyajñam brahma japet ādhidaivikam eva ca
idam śaraṇam ajñānām idam eva vijānatām
eṣa ṣoḍaśa māsa ante sarva rogāt vimucyate
dhīḥ vidyā satyam akrodhaḥ daśakam dharma lakṣaṇam
tayoḥ tulyam mṛtam hema sarva tulyam mṛtam ghanam
candra vitteśayoḥ ca eva mātrāḥ nirhṛtya śāśvatīḥ
liptvā ca mekhalā madhyam cūrṇena atra rasam kṣipet
saḥ agniḥ bhavati vāyuḥ ca saḥ arkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāj
agnim ca kurute dīptam kapha vātam niyacchati
yadā tāpaḥ bhavet tasya madhuram tatra dīyate
kāma ātmā viṣamaḥ kṣudraḥ daṇḍena eva nihanyate
atas tu viparītasya nṛpateḥ ajita ātmanaḥ
tebhyaḥ adhigacchet vinayam vinīta ātmā api nityaśas
iti sarvatra
āsya antara sthitā kuryāt sarva siddhīḥ cira āyuṣaḥ
idam atra kāraṇam na tu artha sadbhāvaḥ
vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tat sarvam sadyas siddhi karam priye
śrī gurau yatra tatra api piṇḍa bhūmi sthita upalāḥ
kṛṣṇa varṇaḥ bhavet śūdraḥ priye syāt adhama adhamaḥ
areḥ anantaram mitram udāsīnam tayoḥ param
yadā avagacchet āyatyām ādhikyam dhruvam ātmanaḥ
manyeta arim yadā rājā sarvathā balavattaram
nigraham prakṛtīnām ca kuryāt yaḥ ari balasya ca
prājñam kulīnam śūram ca dakṣam dātāram eva ca
mānam lajjām kulam śīlam kutsām dambham ca vañcanām
anya upāya śatena api na dehaḥ dhāryate sadā
vahniḥ śabda sparśa rūpa mayaḥ salilam ucyate
viparītena ca aṅguṣṭham vāmam vāma kareṇa ca
śukram tu śveta varṇam syāt pravāla ābham rajaḥ smṛtam
jarā ca maraṇam na asti duṣṭa sattva bhayam tathā
daṇḍam dakṣiṇa hastena dadhānam mṛtyu nāśanam
deśaḥ dhanyataraḥ ślāghyaḥ puṇya kṣetram ca pāvanam
kaṣāya kalka sarpīṃṣi bhakṣyān lehān payāṃsi ca
strīṇām atiprasaṅgena śoṇitam yasya dṛśyate
na ca kevalam saṃhitā mātram eva asti
sabhām vā na praveṣṭavyam vaktavyam vā samañjasam
evam kṛte rasendraḥ asau badhyate na atra saṃśayaḥ
tārasya patra lepena ardha ardhe kāñcana uttamam
varṇa krameṇa sarvāṇi paśyet kāryāṇi kāryiṇām
tān śiṣyāt caura daṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
śata aṃśa vedha kartā ayam deha siddhi karaḥ bhavet
rājā tat upayuñjānaḥ caurasya āpnoti kilbiṣam
nayet tathā anumānena dharmasya nṛpatiḥ padam
paśyati uṣṇa udakam yatra vāsam tatra eva kārayet
eṣām gandha apahāram tu kurute tat ca vedhakam
tam mukhe kṣaṇikam jātam karṇa deśe tu vāsaram
a deśyam yaḥ ca diśati nirdiśya apahnute ca yaḥ
na śrama ārtaḥ na kāma ārtaḥ na kruddhaḥ na api taskaraḥ
phaladbhiḥ iva kṛcchreṇa vāta āghātena mehati
śarkarā saṃbhavasya etat mūtrāghātasya lakṣaṇam
atha mardanam
upadekṣyāmi tattvena yena sarvam bhaviṣyati
hiṃsanti manujān yeṣu prāyaśas divaseṣu tu
nidrānāśaḥ ca tasmin tu bhaviṣyati bhavanti atha
gorakṣakān vāṇijikān tathā kāru kuśīlavān
trīn ca anugacchati rasaḥ lavaṇaḥ kaṭukaḥ dvayam
catuṣkān vakṣyāmaḥ
nadī jalam rūkṣam uṣṇam udamantham tathā ātapam
brāhmaṇa abhyupapattau ca śapathe na asti pātakam
idam eva kartavyam iti niyogaḥ
aparāṇi api yantra ādīni upayogam ca yaugikam
tṛtīyam dhanadaṇḍam tu vadha daṇḍam atas param
prathamam tat pramāṇānām trasareṇum pracakṣate
māsasya vṛddhim gṛhṇīyāt varṇānām anupūrvaśas
avahāryau bhavetām tau dīrghakālam avasthitau
bhaṅge ca yuñjyāt phalakam carma valka kuśa ādi ca
an ādeyasya ca ādānāt ādeyasya ca varjanāt
tathā anyān kṣetra jān rogān rogān jatru ūrdhva saṃbhavān
sa tathā eva grahītavyaḥ yathā dāyaḥ tathā grahaḥ
sākṣī abhāve praṇidhibhiḥ vayaḥ rūpa samanvitaiḥ
asvāminā kṛtaḥ yaḥ tu dāyaḥ vikrayaḥ eva vā
kṛtsnam eva labheta aṃśam anyena eva ca kārayet
purāṇa saṃhitām etām yaḥ paṭhet vā śṛṇoti ca
ṛṣibhiḥ sevyamānam tu nānā śāstra viśāradaiḥ
saṃsāra arṇava magnānām tena ca eṣā kṛpā smṛtā
etat kathaya me sarvam yaḥ asi saḥ asi namaḥ astu te
na ca asau pakṣi rāj tasmin na striyaḥ na ca devatāḥ
kalpa ante yat bhavet kaṣṭam lokānām tattvam eva ca
asya antyasya ca kalpasya vyavasthām kathaya prabho
deva traye bhavet bhaktiḥ kṣayāt pāpasya karmaṇaḥ
namaḥ astu te puṇya jale namaḥ makaragāmini
śrutam deśam ca jātim ca karma śarīram eva ca
brāhmaṇa kṣatriyābhyām tu daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ vijānatā
gateṣu teṣu rāja indra aham ekaḥ sthitaḥ tadā
stenānām nigrahāt asya yaśaḥ rāṣṭram ca vardhate
yāvat kamaṇḍalum vīkṣe śuṣkam tatra api tat jalam
dvitīye janmani bhavet hradasya anucara utkaṭaḥ
sṛṣṭi pālana saṃhārān tvam sadā kuruṣe namaḥ
acireṇa eva kālena kuryām yuṣmad sukha āvaham
kāni dānāni dīyante yeṣām ca syāt mahat phalam
pāda abhyaṅgam śiraḥ abhyaṅgam snānam śayyā āsanāni ca
sugandhi kusumaiḥ dhūpaiḥ tathā karpūra kuṅkumaiḥ
idam tu dhanibhiḥ deyam anyaiḥ deyam yathā ucyate
strī vipra abhyupapattau ca ghnan dharmeṇa na duṣyati
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yat pṛṣṭaḥ aham tvayā adhunā
anya deśa kṛtam pāpam asmin kṣetre vinaśyati
vismayāt hṛṣṭa roma aham jātaḥ asmi muni sattama
putra dāra samopetaḥ jīvet ca śaradaḥ śatam
tasya pārśva gataḥ rakṣaḥ vinayāt avanim gataḥ
tena eva jāta mātreṇa rāvaḥ muktaḥ mahātmanā
eṣā te nara śārdūla garjana utpattiḥ uttamā
tiṣṭha yāvat yugasya antam punarjanma hi avāpsyasi
eṣa tad sambhavaḥ tāta dārutīrthasya suvrata
yat kṛtam śuddha bhāvena tat sarvam saphalam bhavet
bahu vipra janaḥ yatra gṛha dharmeṇa vartate
ṛtvijam yaḥ tyajet yājyaḥ yājyam ca ṛtvij tyajet yadi
tvam lakṣmīḥ tvam smṛtiḥ medhā tvam dhṛtiḥ tvam varānane
upavāsa paraḥ yaḥ tu tasmin tīrthe narādhipa
dadyāt
hemante jala madhya sthaḥ vāyubhakṣaḥ śatam samāḥ
atapat ca ghṛta śvāsaḥ kuṇḍalaḥ bharata ṛṣabha
caturthe varṣa śatake tutoṣa vṛṣavāhanaḥ
kasya putraḥ mahābhāga kimartham kṛtavān tapaḥ
yaḥ tatra kurute śrāddham toyam pibati nityaśas
upāyaḥ śobhanaḥ devi yaḥ me manasi vartate
tathā iti ca uktaḥ kamalāsanena sura asuraiḥ vandita pāda padmaḥ
anekāntaḥ ca hetuḥ te tad śarīra ādinā bhavet
raṇa prayogaiḥ yudhyantau yuyudhāte śiva andhakau
ādeśaḥ dīyatām deva kaḥ yāsyati yama ālayam
anna dānāt param dānam na bhūtam na bhaviṣyati
satyam ca eva aṣṭamam puṣpam ebhiḥ tuṣyanti devatāḥ
tiṣṭhate mṛga rūpeṇa mṛga yūtha caraḥ tadā
nāsayā āsyena vā pītam vaṭa śuṅga aṣṭakam tathā
karpūra pūrvakaḥ ca anyaḥ tatra ādyaḥ dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ
dhātu caram iti kaḥ arthaḥ dhātu grasana artham iti bhāvaḥ
lavaṇa amlaiḥ iti
pādena yonim ekena bhugnaḥ anyena gudam ca yaḥ
sama aṃśakam bhāgam iti
ghanībhūtam iva ākāśam ākāśam iva yaḥ ghanam
na yāti yasya ca āhāraḥ kaṇṭham kaṇṭha āmayāt ṛte
aṃguṣṭhena bhavet tasya niṣphalaḥ tasya tad japaḥ
yācitam parakīyam ca tathā paryuṣitam ca yat
mardanam atra pūrva ukta rasaiḥ iti vyavahāraḥ
śuddha māṇikya jaḥ ghṛṣṭaḥ na eva lohena bhidyate
āśu sarvasya vapuṣaḥ vyāptiḥ doṣeṇa jāyate
svapne tad varṇa darśi tvam bhavati asmin bhaviṣyati
alpa auṣadham ca pittasya vamanam na vara auṣadham
śuddham tāpyam iti
svarabhedaḥ bhavet tatra kṣāmaḥ rūkṣaḥ calaḥ svaraḥ
yāma dvayam
jambīram jambīra phala rasaḥ
purīṣam vāta viṣ mūtra saṅgam kurvīta dāruṇam
akṣa pramāṇa vaṭakān kuryāt evam pṛthak pṛthak
daśānām tulya bhāgā ca tasya ardham śigru mūlakam
jitvā indram katham adya tvam lakṣmaṇasya vaśam gataḥ
sāmarthyāt ca atra vibhajet bāhya abhyantara lakṣaṇam
mūtra dhāraṇa śīlasya mūtra jaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ
adya prabhṛti lokān trīn sarve dānava rākṣasāḥ
iti evam āhāra lāghavam tantre siddham
na ati mandaḥ analaḥ laulyam na ca syāt virasam mukham
tulyaḥ kuṇapa gandhena picchilaḥ pīta lohitaḥ
atra idam yama prakaraṇam samāptam
kāryasya āśraya rakṣaṇāya iti bhāvaḥ
ślakṣṇa pīta ābha paryantam maṇḍalam parimaṇḍalam
varṇena eva īdṛś ubhayam kṛcchram tat ca uttarottaram
kuṭile balam abhyadhikam rāgaḥ tīkṣṇe tu pannage snehaḥ
śukrasya śīghram utsargam saṅgam vikṛtim eva vā
kāla antareṇa gambhīram sarvān dhātūn abhidravat
syāt tayoḥ pīḍanāt hāniḥ āyuṣaḥ ca balasya ca
cukrodha ca daśagrīvaḥ babhau hṛṣṭaḥ ca rāghavaḥ
karaṇīyam prayatnena rasa śāstrasya vartmanā
dvitīyam japtvā gaṇa ādhipatyam āpnoti
hasta anubhava yogena kṛtam samyak śrutam na hi
ekākī tena dahye aham gatāḥ te phala bhoginaḥ
śivayoḥ melanam samyak tasya haste bhaviṣyati
viṣāda vimukhāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ gata cetasaḥ
hīna varṇasya hemnaḥ ca patrāṇi eva tu kārayet
babhūva tumulam yuddham anyonya vadha kāṅkṣiṇoḥ
agni dīpta mukhān bāṇān tathā sūrya mukhān api
sudhā yuktam viṣam yena sudhā adhika guṇam tathā
rukma garbha girau jātam paramam tat rasāyanam
mahiṣasya purīṣeṇa snāyāt śītena vāriṇā
patadbhiḥ ca diśaḥ dīptaiḥ candra sūrya grahaiḥ iva
etasmin antare kruddhaḥ rāghavasya anujaḥ balī
idam loham kaṭu uṣṇam ca tiktam ca śiśiram tathā
lehaiḥ dhūmaiḥ tathā abhyaṅga sveda seka avagāhanaiḥ
pacet
kapham śuddhaiḥ ca taiḥ puṣṭim kuryāt samyak vahan rasaḥ
sa dattvā tumulam yuddham rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
idam eva gamiṣyāmi gṛhītvā śikharam gireḥ
puṭāni evam kṛte trīṇi śatāni dvādaśa adhikam
drutadrāvam ghāta saham dṛṣṭam evam mayā khalu
kṣārāḥ sarve malam hanyuḥ amlam śodhana jāraṇam
bhavet viṃśati vāreṇa sindūra sadṛśam ghanam
bhavanti atīva tīvrāṇi rasāt api adhikāni ca
khecaraḥ ca amaraḥ proktaḥ dehadaḥ mṛtyunāśanaḥ
eraṇḍa taila gavya ājyaiḥ mātuluṅga rasena ca
krimiśaṅkhaḥ krimijalajaḥ krimivāriruhaḥ ca jantukambuḥ ca
gulma śūla āmaya ghnaḥ ca netra doṣa nikṛntanaḥ
dadāti paramām puṣṭim balam bhīma bala upamam
ghanam snigdham mṛdu svaccham dāhe chede sitam guru
nihanti sakalān rogān tad tad doṣa samudbhavān
ājam kṣīram ghṛtam māṃsam kravyād māṃsam ca śoṣa jit
na hi idam vidyate karma suhṛdaḥ hita kāṅkṣiṇaḥ
srutam ātma gatam tejaḥ saḥ agrahīt eka pāṇinā
nānā varṇa guṇa āḍhyāḥ vijñeyāḥ sphaṭika jātayaḥ prājñaiḥ
ittham bhūtasya sūtasya martya mṛtyu gada chidaḥ
caturtha adhyāya nirdiṣṭa prakāreṇa rase khalu
taruṇaḥ roga nāśa artham deha rakṣā karaḥ tathā
madyasya viṣa sādṛśyāt viṣam tu utkarṣa vṛttibhiḥ
sthāvaram jaṅgamam ca eva saṃyogāt ca yathā viṣam
astram makaraketoḥ yā puruṣa arthaḥ balasya yā
arka kṣīra odanam mardyam arka mūla draveṇa vā
rogān hanti mṛtaḥ nāgaḥ sevyaḥ raṅgaḥ api tad guṇaḥ
cikṣepa ca punar bāṇān vajra pāta sama svanān
cakāra śara jālena rāghavaḥ vimukham ripum
na eva rātrim na divasam na muhūrtam na ca kṣaṇam
sukha upāyena he nātha śastra kṣāra agnibhiḥ vinā
na samyak galitam yat tu tena eva vidhinā punar
rasaiḥ paṅka samam kṛtvā pacet tat gomaya agninā
martyānām upakārāya triṣu lokeṣu durlabham
vīrya utkarṣam param yāti sarvaiḥ ekaikaśas api vā
kāle sādhāraṇe vyabhre na ati durbalam arśasam
yasya vājeṣu pavanaḥ phale pāvaka bhāskarau
śarīram ākāśa mayam gaurave meru mandarau
yaḥ na vetti kṛpā rāśim rasa hari hara ātmakam
cetaḥ etaiḥ anāviddham sthitam sattve prasīdati
tamasaḥ tu rajaḥ tasmāt sattvam yat brahma darśanam
sarvathā sarva bhūtānām na asti mṛtyuḥ alakṣaṇaḥ
vāsudeva param jñānam vāsudeva param tapaḥ
śuddha sūta samam hema khalve kuryāt ca golakam
tāmram tikta amla madhuram kaṣāyam śītalam param
vāñchitam bhojanam dadyāt kuryāt candana lepanam
sa yām ādyaiḥ sura gaṇaiḥ apāt svāyambhuva antaram
mṛta tāmra abhra lohānām hiṅgulam ca palam palam
kalau naṣṭa dṛśām eṣa purāṇa arkaḥ adhunā uditaḥ
aham ca adhyagamam tatra niviṣṭaḥ tad anugrahāt
rājyam vā triṣu lokeṣu na etat arhati bhāṣitum
hate tasmin na kuryuḥ hi tarjanam vānara uttama
kṣiptvā triṃśat pale pācyam tad rasam māṃsa piṇḍakam
śuktena mātuluṅgasya svarasena ārdrakasya ca
āḍhakam sarpiṣaḥ peyam tat agni bala vṛddhaye
anna pānaiḥ nayet śāntim dīptam agnim iva ambubhiḥ
yāvat tiṣṭhati asau lepaḥ tāvat vīryam na muñcati
snānasya aprasaṅgāt ca
viparītena gṛhṇāti bhāvān anyān ca yaḥ naraḥ
śiraḥ rahitam ātmānam pakṣam ekam sa jīvati
tīrtha snānena dānena tapasā sukṛtena vā
dhmātam tat eva sarvam giriṇā adhika śodhanaiḥ vāpāt
pratyaya artham tu lokānām trayāṇām satya saṃśrayaḥ
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājya sthaḥ dīrgham āyuḥ avāpnuhi
suhṛdbhiḥ bāndhavaiḥ ca eva jñātibhiḥ sva janena ca
ādau mala lakṣaṇam uktam
puṣkara eraṇḍayoḥ mūlam yava dhanva yavāsakam
kṣāram gṛhītvā kṣīra ājya takra madya ādibhiḥ pibet
pāne jalam akṣāram madhurāṇi yāni kāni śastāni
piṣṭam bhuñjīta rasam bali sahitam siddhi daḥ bhavati
svarṇam tāram ca tāmram ca vaṅgaḥ nāgaḥ tu pañcamaḥ
evam nava puṭam dadyāt daśamam ca mahāpuṭam
yatra aṅgam dṛśyate lohe tīkṣṇam loham tat uttamam
dalāni muñcati anale pinākam bhekam sva rāvam kurute anala stham
vahnau kṣiptam tu nirdhūmam yat tu liṅga upamam bhavet
vālukāyantram etat hi yantram tatra budhaiḥ smṛtam
dravya antarasya saṃsargāt santi anye api guṇāḥ tayoḥ
punar mardyam punar pācyam sapta vārān punar punar
kṛtvā tad madhya gam vajram mriyate dhmātam eva hi
iti āntaraślokāḥ
arghyam pratigṛhāṇa idam ayodhyām śvas gamiṣyasi
trīn ca anyān payasā eva adyāt phala amlena rasena vā
pibet ikṣu rasam ca anu jaṭharāṇām nivṛttaye
rāghavasya harīṇām ca katham āsīt samāgamaḥ
lakṣmaṇaḥ rāvaṇa sutam svayam rāmaḥ tu rāvaṇam
rarāja pṛthu dīrgha akṣaḥ vajrapāṇiḥ iva aparaḥ
pūrṇaiḥ ghaṭaiḥ pratīkṣadhvam tathā kuruta vānarāḥ
sarva vānara vṛddhāḥ ca ye ca anye vānara īśvarāḥ
uvāca lakṣmaṇam rāmaḥ dharma jñam dharma vatsalaḥ
pāṇḍu rogeṣu kuśalaḥ śopha uktam ca kriyā kramam
na śuddham na mṛtam svarṇam roga vargam karoti ca
rakṣāyai loha rasayoḥ ayam eva ekam udbhavam
tām tu dṛṣṭvā tathā bhūtām tṛṇabinduḥ atha abravīt
parituṣṭaḥ asmi te vatsa karmaṇā anena suvrata
taptam taptam ca tat vajram śata vāraiḥ mṛtam bhavet
nirbījam api badhnāti rasam sarva viṣa apahā
garbhe śuṣke tu vātena bālānām ca viśuṣyatām
kautūhalam kṛtam mahyam nuda bhānuḥ yathā tamaḥ
kṛtadārāḥ tu te rāma sukeśa tanayāḥ prabho
apatyam kathyamānam tat mayā tvam śṛṇu rāghava
daśa śīrṣaḥ prasūtaḥ ayam daśagrīvaḥ bhaviṣyati
śṛṇu ca api vacaḥ bhūyas prītasya iha śubham mama
punar tāni bhaviṣyanti tathā eva tava rākṣasa
tathā ayam ca avatāraḥ te bhuvaḥ bhāra jihīrṣayā
evam uktaḥ gṛhītvā tu tat vacaḥ pitṛ gauravāt
bhartuḥ ca vipriyam vīra kṛtavān kula pāṃsanaḥ
dvi karṇasya tu mantrasya brahmā api antam na gacchati
yathā aṇḍam taruṇam pūrṇam taila pātram yathā tathā
caturaḥ lokapālān tān nayiṣyāmi yama kṣayam
sākṣāt maheśvareṇa evam kṛta nāmā sa rāvaṇaḥ
dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīm pālīm anyena pāṇinā
atha kim tat karaṇam iti ucyate
svāsthyam tābhyām aduṣṭābhyām duṣṭābhyām roga saṃbhavaḥ
tasmāt atra apasavyam nāma yat savyāt viparītam
tālu māṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam
mohena ayam janaḥ dhvastaḥ kleśam svam na avabudhyate
vinamya jṛmbhamāṇasya śakṛt mūtra pravartanam
devāḥ pitaraḥ ca
varuṇasya ālayam divyam apaśyat rākṣasa adhipaḥ
snāna vastra vasā māṃsa madya kṣīra guḍa ādi ca
yat uktam siddha gurubhiḥ
bhaviṣyati sadā kurvan yat vakṣyasi vacaḥ svayam
na ca abhuktasya karmaṇaḥ kṣayaḥ bhavati
yuñjyāt tāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtim manaḥ
śeṣa abhāvāt
gṛhītvā tena pṛṣṭā asmi kasya tvam iti rakṣasā
anyathā sarva anumāna ucchedaḥ eva syāt
yathā ukta guṇa lābha paryantam iti bhāvaḥ
sarvathā tu mahat karma kariṣyati bala utkaṭaḥ
nānā praharaṇaiḥ kruddhaḥ raṇam eva abhyavartata
sirā vimokṣaḥ snigdhasya trivṛt śreṣṭham virecanam
nirgacchataḥ tu śakrasya paruṣam pavanaḥ vavau
sūta arka bhasma artham rasa bhasma artham tāmra bhasma artham ca
para sainyasya madhyena yāvat antam nayasva mām
mukhasya iti
samyak chinne bhavet svāsthyam hīna ati cheda jān gadān
ekākī sa gataḥ tatra yatra yatra ca te mṛgāḥ
upāyaḥ kathyatām me adya yaḥ te manasi vartate
vimāna stham dadarśa asau pumāṃsam divya rūpiṇam
gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjām gadābhṛtaḥ
śrāddham cakruḥ prayatnena śraddhayā pūta cetasā
purāṇam paṭhitam bhadre brāhmaṇaiḥ vedapāragaiḥ
saṃsāra sāgarāt bhītaḥ satyam bhadre vadāmi te
prasādaḥ kriyatām devi kṣamasva adya janaiḥ saha
dāna ādīnām vā pūrva uktānām viśeṣaṇam kim asti na iti
yathā uktena vidhānena nābhi mātre jale kṣipet
mātṛtīrthāt param tīrtham na bhūtam na bhaviṣyati
deva dānava gandharvaḥ bhasmasāt yātu tad kṣaṇāt
śrauta smārta kriyā yuktān para dāra parāṅmukhān
sadyas prīti karam toyam annam ca nṛpa sattama
pṛthivyām devatāḥ sarvāḥ sarva tīrthāni yāni tu
śāpasya upaśamam deva kuru śarma mama prabho
sa hataḥ tena saṅgena kaṇvena muni sattama
mārga gaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ harṣa udyuktaḥ tad gata mānasaḥ
śrāddham someśvare pārtha yaḥ kuryāt gata matsaraḥ
iti te kathitam sarvam tīrtha māhātmyam uttamam
mucyate sarva pāpebhyaḥ tīrtham kṛtvā param nṛpa
kṣīrodam sāgaram gatvā astuvan te jalaśāyinam
avīciḥ narakaḥ yatra yatra yāmala parvatau
hiraṇya bhūmi dānena tila dānena bhūyasā
tat tu tīrtham idam puṇyam iti evam śūlinaḥ vacaḥ
evam uktaḥ tayā saḥ atha kṣaṇam dhyātvā abravīt idam
bhinna vṛtti karān pāpān patitān śūdra sevanān
vṛthā kleśaḥ bhavet asyāḥ prabhāyāḥ parameśvara
evam devi kariṣyāmi tava vākyam varānane
śva biḍāla vadhāt ghoram sarpa śūdra udbhavam tathā
provāca nṛpa śārdūla guhyāt guhyataram śubham
tṛptāḥ sma sarva kāmaiḥ tu suvrate tava darśanāt
matsya aśva prakarāḥ ca eva kūrma grāha ādayaḥ api vā
rāmaḥ lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau bharataḥ tatra sambhavāt
puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ
kīrtim vitanvatā loke ātmanaḥ adhokṣaja ātmanaḥ
nadyaḥ nadāḥ samudrāḥ ca varaḥ me ca akṣayaḥ bhavet
rudrasya bhavanam yāti mṛtaḥ na asti atra saṃśayaḥ
devarājaḥ jagāma asau tīrthāni āyatanāni ca
hetuḥ ekaḥ jagannāthaḥ nā anyaḥ vidyeta bhāskarāt
kim tasya bahubhiḥ mantraiḥ kaṃṭha śoṣaṇa tatparaiḥ
virājam atapat svena tejasā eṣām vivṛttaye
nirabhidyanta devānām tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu
tasya tvam bhaga yuktasya dayām kuru dvijottama
samam tat veda viduṣā tīrthe somasya tat phalam
yaḥ tu unmukha tvāt varṇānām mukhyaḥ abhūt brāhmaṇaḥ guruḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet bala keśavau
yat bhūtam yat bhaviṣyat ca tīrtha māhātmyam uttamam
tatra soma grahe puṇyam tat puṇyam labhate naraḥ
catur vedeṣu yat puṇyam satya vādiṣu yat phalam
tīrthānām paramam tīrtham nirmitam śambhunā purā
svātmā eva ayam vasati sakala prāṇinām īśvaraḥ antar
śrotum icchāmi vipra indra bhīma arjuna yamaiḥ saha
piṇḍa dānāt phalam tat ca labhate na atra saṃśayaḥ
jāyate rāja rāja indraiḥ pūjyamānaḥ nṛpaḥ mahān
dṛṣṭvā ātmānam sa kuṣṭhena vyāptam brāhmaṇa sattamaḥ
tat aham śrotum icchāmi param kautūhalam hi me
tathāśabdaḥ sādhana traya upasaṃhāra arthaḥ
tasmāt tapasaḥ phalam viśeṣa artham abhidhīyate yogaḥ atigatim iti
devasya pūraṇam kuryāt ghṛtena ghṛtakambalam
tat sarvam sapta janmāni hi akṣayam phalam aśnute
tat phalam jāyate pārtha hi ekena śiva yoginā
tasmin tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pāpa karmā api bhārata
mṛtasya eva tu yat dānam parokṣe tad samam smṛtam
snātānām sarpatīrthe tu narāṇām bhuvi bhārata
tatra tīrthe nṛpa śreṣṭha snātvā tat phalam āpnuyāt
sa gacchet paramam lokam yaḥ suraiḥ api durlabhaḥ
na dṛṣṭam na śrutam tāta śūla sthena tapaḥ kṛtam
tathā pūrva kṛtam karma kartāram upagacchati
rājñā ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhūṣaṇa ācchādana aśanaiḥ
yatra tatra sthitaḥ vṛkṣān paśyate tīrtha tatparaḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu bahu roga ārtam agnim deva mukham surāḥ
eka kālam dvi kālam vā tri kālam ca api yaḥ sadā
kim uktam śrotum icchāmi param kautūhalam hi me
pūta ātmā tena puṇyena rudra lokam sa gacchati
ṣaṣṭhaḥ tu brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ mānasaḥ bhṛgu sattamaḥ
jala bindu kuśa agreṇa māse māse pibet ca saḥ
kim karomi suraśreṣṭha dhyātaḥ kena eva hetunā
nirmitam bhṛguṇā tāta sarva pātaka nāśanam
adya prabhṛti vipra indra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
evam uktvā sthitaḥ devaḥ bhṛgukacche ambikā tathā
katham atra suraśreṣṭha kedāra ākhyaḥ sthitaḥ svayam
dvitīyam eke prajanam manyante strīṣu tad vidaḥ
indraḥ tvam pakṣiṇām madhye bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ
lakṣmīḥ uvāca
pauruṣe kriyamāṇe api na siddhiḥ jāyate yadi
manyadhvam jātam ekasya tat sarvam paramātmanaḥ
yadi deva aparādhe api na asmāsu kupitam tava
draṣṭā asi rūpasya parasya vettā śrotā ca śabdasya hare tvam ekaḥ
tathā tvam api rāja indra sarva bhūteṣu keśavam
devarāya pradātavyā yadi kanyā anumanyate
ādadīta na śūdraḥ api śulkam duhitaram dadan
śrīḥ uvāca
śeṣāḥ tam upajīveyuḥ yathā eva pitaram tathā
śūla agre tapyamānena tapaḥ tena kṛtam tadā
pūrva karma vipākena dharmeṇa tapasi sthitāḥ
idam eva param vipra sarveṣām tu bhaviṣyati
kāmikam sarva tīrthānām prāṇinām siddhi dāyakam
tatra tīrthe aśvinau devau surūpau bhiṣajām varau
sarveṣām eva ratnānām kāñcanam ratnam uttamam
śrotum icchāmi vipra indra param kautūhalam hi me
bahvīṣu ca ekajātānām nānā strīṣu nibodhata
agniḥ hi devāḥ sarve suvarṇam ca hutāśanāt
tasyām jātāḥ samāṃśāḥ syuḥ yadi putra śatam bhavet
kṛtvā tu khaṇḍa khaṇḍāni sa devaḥ parameśvaraḥ
yasya asti śaktiḥ tejaḥ vā kṣatriyasya kula adhamaḥ
kena idam ātma nāśāya hi ajñānāt sāhasam kṛtam
iti visarjana mantraḥ
puṇyaiḥ ca eva tathā kuryāt gītaiḥ nṛtyaiḥ prabodhanam
namaḥ dhātre vidhātre ca śaraṇyāya namaḥ namaḥ
ye ete abhihitāḥ putrāḥ prasaṅgāt anya bīja jāḥ
sarvāsām ekapatnīnām ekā ced putriṇī bhavet
pitā haret aputrasya riktham bhrātaraḥ eva ca
yatra veda nidhiḥ vipraḥ mahat taptvā tapaḥ purā
gatvā parārtham tīrtha ādau ṣoḍaśa aṃśa phalam labhet
kartavyam jñāti vargasya para arthe dharma sādhanam
ete śrutvā eva pāpebhyaḥ mucyante na atra saṃśayaḥ
svakāt api ca vittāt hi svasya bhartuḥ anājñayā
kṛta puṇyāḥ ca te lokāḥ śokāya na bhavanti te
kurukṣetre ca yat puṇyam prabhāse puṣkare tathā
rurodha narmadā vegam bāhubhiḥ sa tadā arjunaḥ
vardhantam ambhasaḥ vegam pūrvām āśām praviśya tu
badhyamāne daśagrīve siddha cāraṇa devatāḥ
pitāmaha sutaḥ ca api pulastyaḥ muni sattamaḥ
rāvaṇam tu mumoca atha sva kakṣāt kapi sattamaḥ
śilpa upacāra yuktāḥ ca nipuṇāḥ paṇya yoṣitaḥ
na bale vidyate tulyaḥ na gatau na matau paraḥ
yathā ayam vāyuputraḥ tu kramate ambaram uttamam
sūrya dāha bhayāt rakṣan tuṣāra caya śītalaḥ
