yena hetunā tulyam atulyam tat upariṣṭāt vakṣyāmaḥ
śaktasya śakya karaṇāt
āpnoti iha ādityasya jayam
samudraḥ nidhanam
mahān prajayā paśubhiḥ bhavati
avayavāḥ śabda sparśa rasa rūpa gandhāḥ taiḥ saha
tatra prīti ātmakam sattvam
vayam jayema helābhiḥ dasyūn durga patiḥ yathā
sattvam laghu prakāśakam ca
anye tantavaḥ anyaḥ paṭaḥ na
evam ebhiḥ hetubhiḥ asti ātmā śarīrāt vyatiriktaḥ
sattva rajaḥ tamāṃsi trayaḥ guṇāḥ karma kartṛ bhāvena pravartante na puruṣaḥ
etad artham pradhānasya api puruṣeṇa saṃyogaḥ kaivalya artham
dhyāyan jajāpa virajam brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam
aiśvaryam īśvara bhāvaḥ
evam tri kālam ābhyantaram karaṇam iti
sarva indriya gatam triṣu api kāleṣu sarvam
prākṛtāḥ kathyante
viparyayāt tuṣṭi siddhīnām eva bheda kramaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ
tathā suhṛd prāptiḥ
dānam
prati puruṣa vimokṣa artham
na dvitīyā prakṛtiḥ asti mūrti bhede jāti bhedāt
na tasya kāryam karaṇam ca vidyate na tad samaḥ ca abhyadhikaḥ ca dṛśyate
haviḥ āropa mātreṇa vahniḥ dīptaḥ yathā bhavet
kārya virodhi karma
manasaḥ gatiḥ iti manasā pāṭaliputra gamana ādi rūpā
bhavataḥ bāhu vīryeṇa prasādāt mādhavasya ca
vijitā iyam mahī kṛtsnā kṛṣṇa bāhu bala āśrayāt
guhyam etat tu devānām kathayiṣyāmi te nṛpa
daurātmyam ca api karṇasya viditvā tam uvāca ha
prasādam kuru me brahman astra lubdhasya bhārgava
vimuktaḥ kuṇḍalābhyām ca sahajena ca varmaṇā
śalyāt tejaḥ vadhāt ca api vāsudeva nayena ca
kubera droṇayoḥ ca eva kṛpasya ca mahātmanaḥ
vayam eva asya lokasya vināśe kāraṇam smṛtāḥ
upetya tasya avabhṛtham pūtāḥ sarve bhavanti te
mūḍhānām artha hīnānām teṣām enaḥ tu vidyate
deva vaṃśān pitṛ vaṃśān brahma vaṃśān ca śāśvatān
tapaḥ śreṣṭham prajānām hi mūlam etat na saṃśayaḥ
viśākha yūpe devānām sarveṣām agnayaḥ citāḥ
te api karma eva kurvanti vidhim paśyasva pārthiva
ati āśramān ayam sarvān iti āhuḥ veda niścayāḥ
āśramān tulayā sarvān dhṛtān āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ
yaḥ dharmaḥ yat sukham vā syāt dviṣatām tat tathā astu naḥ
vāci daṇḍaḥ brāhmaṇānām kṣatriyāṇām bhuja arpaṇam
madhyasthān sarva bhūteṣu dāntān śama parāyaṇān
sa ca daṇḍe samāyattaḥ paśya daṇḍasya gauravam
āgatiḥ ca gatiḥ ca eva lokasya viditā tava
uṣṇena bādhyate śītam śītena uṣṇam prabādhyate
miṣatām pāṇḍu putrāṇām na tasya smartum arhasi
tābhyām vimuktaḥ pāśābhyām padam āpnoti tad param
tūṣṇīṃbhūtam tu rājānam punar eva arjunaḥ abravīt
veda jñānam ca te kṛtsnam tapaḥ ca caritam mahat
daṇḍa dhāraṇam ati ugram prajānām paripālanam
teṣām jyāyaḥ tu kaunteya daṇḍa dhāraṇam ucyate
tayoḥ āvasathau āstām ramaṇīyau pṛthak pṛthak
eṣa dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇām prajānām paripālanam
ātmā api ca ayam na mama sarvā api pṛthivī mama
śṛṇomi te nārada vācam etām vicitra arthām srajam iva puṇya gandhām
śāpa doṣam ca tam bhartuḥ śrutvā svām prakṛtim gatā
prajānām pālanam dharmaḥ rājñām rājīva locana
tāni akāryāṇi me brahman dahanti ca tapanti ca
evam api aśubham karma na bhūtam na bhaviṣyati
kāṅkṣamāṇāḥ śriyam kṛtsnām pṛthivyām ca mahat yaśaḥ
vināśa hetu kāri tve yaiḥ te kāla vaśam gatāḥ
kaṅkaḥ madguḥ ca gṛdhrāḥ ca kāka ulūkam tathā eva ca
sa te sarva rahasyeṣu saṃśayān manasi sthitān
tat sarvam grasate vegāt yathā devaḥ maheśvaraḥ
yat anyat akarot vipra tat me vaktum iha arhasi
śama ātmakam ṛjum putram labheyam japatām vara
dadāha kārtavīryasya śailān atha vanāni ca
avartanta dvijāgryāṇām dāreṣu bharata ṛṣabha
yat hi bhūtam bhaviṣyat ca bhavat ca puruṣa ṛṣabha
kṛtsnān hi vividhān dharmān cāturvarṇyasya vetti ayam
yaśasaḥ śreyasaḥ ca eva mūlam mām viddhi kaurava
samaya tyāginaḥ lubdhān gurūn api ca keśava
utsavānām samājānām kriyāḥ ketana jāḥ tathā
pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca sarva adhikaraṇeṣu ca
anayā kim mayā kāryam tat me tattvena śaṃsata
na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syāt na rakṣeyam paśūn iti
yat skannam asya tat pūrvam yat a skannam tat uttaram
sarvadā sarva bhūteṣu brahma āśrama padam bhavet
prakṣipte bhasmanaḥ vallam vallam ca prakṣipet punar
pālanam puruṣa vyāghra gṛha āśrama padam bhavet
bhojanāni atha pānāni rājñe dadyuḥ gṛhāṇi ca
jvalite śītalībhūte tāmram grāhyam mṛtam budhaiḥ
pūrva apakāriṇaḥ hanyāt loka dviṣṭān ca sarvaśas
daśa dharma gatebhyaḥ yat vasu bahu alpam eva ca
bāhyān kuryāt nara śreṣṭha doṣāya syuḥ hi te anyathā
asmin arthe ca yau ślokau gītau aṅgirasā svayam
ṛtavaḥ ca sukhāḥ sarve bhavanti uta nirāmayāḥ
vyādhayaḥ na bhavanti atra na alpa āyuḥ dṛśyate naraḥ
mucukundasya saṃvādam rājñaḥ vaiśravaṇasya ca
evam eva ātmanaḥ tyāgāt na anyam dharmam viduḥ janāḥ
tathā eva ati udakāt bhītaḥ tasya bhedanam icchati
samarthān yaḥ ca na dveṣṭi samarthān kurute ca yaḥ
śūraḥ ca āryaḥ ca vidvān ca pratipatti viśāradaḥ
sā iyam ābhyantarā tubhyam āpad kṛcchrā sva karma jā
sa buddhvā tasya rāṣṭrasya vyavasāyam hi sarvaśas
sa suhṛd krodhanaḥ lubdhaḥ na mantram śrotum arhati
prajānām rakṣaṇam kāryam na kāryam karma garhitam
para rāṣṭra aṭavī stheṣu yathā sva viṣaye tathā
vaktavyāḥ ca anugṛhṇīdhvam pūjāḥ saha mayā iti ha
dasyavaḥ tad vadhāya iha brahmā kṣatram atha asṛjat
puruṣāṇām samānānām dṛśyate mahat antaram
śriyam jānīta dharmasya mūlam sarva sukhasya ca
dīpta sphuṭita keśāntāḥ sthūla pārśva hanū mukhāḥ
praṇipātam ca gaccheta kāle śatroḥ balīyasaḥ
duṣkaram bata kurvanti mahataḥ arthān tyajanti ye
bravīmi hanta te nītim rājyasya pratipattaye
dadau duhitaram ca asmai ratnāni vividhāni ca
vijigīṣoḥ tathā vṛttam uktam ca eva tathā eva te
kim kāryam sarva dharmāṇām garīyaḥ bhavataḥ matam
yena prīṇāti upādhyāyam tena syāt brahma pūjitam
kasmin kāle vadet satyam kasmin kāle anṛtam vadet
yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha saṃbandhāt mucyate śapathāt iti
mātā pitroḥ ca ye vṛttim vartante dharma kovidāḥ
īśvaram sarva bhūtānām jagataḥ prabhava apyayam
kim pārthivena kartavyam kim ca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet
akāyaḥ ca alpa sāraḥ ca vetasaḥ kūla jaḥ ca vaḥ
anna pāne śarīre ca hitam yat tat bravīhi me
na mūla phala bhogeṣu spṛhām api akarot tadā
na jahyāt ca tanutrāṇam rakṣet ātmānam ātmanā
vasiṣṭham īśam viprāṇām vasūnām jātavedasam
iti idam vasuhomasya śṛṇuyāt yaḥ matam naraḥ
dharma mūlaḥ tu dehaḥ arthaḥ kāmaḥ artha phalam ucyate
brāhmaṇaḥ tu abravīt vākyam kasmin kāle kṣaṇaḥ bhavet
tasmin anugate dharmam puruṣe puruṣaḥ aparaḥ
śīlasya tattvam icchāmi vettum kaurava nandana
dṛṣṭvā aham tam kṛśam vipram bhītaḥ parama durmanāḥ
pūrvam rasasya śodhanam
kṛśa tanuḥ uvāca
udyamaḥ jīvanam kṣatre bāhu vīryāt iti śrutiḥ
pariśaṅkita mukhyasya sruta mantrasya bhārata
na kośaḥ śuddha śaucena na nṛśaṃsena jāyate
hīna kośam hi rājānam avajānanti mānavāḥ
atra sarveṣām iti aśeṣāṇām iti arthaḥ
jagāma ca sva bhavanam caṇḍālaḥ bharata ṛṣabha
gatvā ca mama viśvāsam dattvā ca mama jīvitam
ayam ca sādhu upāyaḥ yat uta
yadi tu arthena me kāryam brūhi kim karavāṇi te
maraṇam dharma tattva jña na mām śaṅkitum arhasi
namaḥ vijñāna vīryāya māyayā idam upeyuṣe
amitram nā eva muñceta bruvantam karuṇāni api
sarāṃsi saritaḥ ca eva kūpāḥ prasravaṇāni ca
caṇḍālasya gṛhe rājan sadyas śastra hatasya ca
śruta cāritra vṛtta āḍhyān pavitram hi etat uttamam
chittvā stambham ca mānam ca prītim icchāmi te nṛpa
āha kadā cīrṇam iti
bālam mṛtam gṛhītvā atha śmaśāna abhimukhāḥ sthitāḥ
asura samīpe asura abhyāśe asurāṇām adhyakṣaḥ iti arthaḥ
iṣṭa bandhu viyogaḥ ca tathā evā alpam ca jīvitam
kula śoka ākaram mūḍhāḥ putram tyaktvā kva yāsyatha
kim vīryam kuśala utsāhaḥ tad vipakṣaḥ kaḥ ucyate
tathā sa śudhyate rājan śṛṇu ca atra vacaḥ mama
dhanuḥ praharaṇam śreṣṭham iti vādaḥ pitāmaha
tatra doṣa kṣaya ārambhe leśaḥ api mama nā īkṣyate
nānā ākṛti balāḥ ca anye jala kṣiti vicāriṇaḥ
suhṛdaḥ ca eva kalyāṇān āśu tyajati kilbiṣī
kuṭumba artheṣu dasyoḥ sa sāhāyyam ca api athā akarot
bāṇa vedhye param yatnam akarot ca eva gautamaḥ
tam dasyu grāmam agamat yatra asau gautamaḥ abhavat
evam uktaḥ sa suhṛdā tadā tena hita eṣiṇā
darśanam rākṣasa indrasya kāṅkṣamāṇaḥ dvijaḥ tadā
ayam baka patiḥ pārśve māṃsa rāśiḥ sthitaḥ mama
puṇya amṛtaiḥ katham tṛptiḥ vipāka madhuraiḥ śivaiḥ
dharmam āśramiṇām śreṣṭham vaktum arhasi pārthiva
tathā tvam api vartasva satya dharma parāyaṇaḥ
na eva tvam vettha sulabham na eva tvam vettha durlabham
jaṅgama sthāvarāṇām ca bhūtānām asura adhipa
indraḥ sṛgāla rūpeṇa babhāṣe kruddha mānasam
manuṣyaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ ca asi śrotriyaḥ ca asi kāśyapa
atha yeṣām punar pāṇī deva dattau daśa aṅgulī
te khalu api ramante ca modante ca hasanti ca
hasta āvāpena gacchanti nāstikāḥ kim atas param
bālaḥ yuvā ca vṛddhaḥ ca yat karoti śubha aśubham
puṣkarāt yadi sambhūtaḥ jyeṣṭham bhavati puṣkaram
meru madhye sthitaḥ brahmā tat brūhi dvijasattama
eṣa mārgaḥ atha yogānām yena gacchanti tat padam
indriyaiḥ tu pradīpa artham kurute buddhi saptamaiḥ
sarva bhūta ātma bhūtaḥ syāt sa gacchet paramām gatim
rame japan mahābhāga kṛtam lokaiḥ sanātanaiḥ
abravīt brāhmaṇaḥ vākyam kṛtvā kuśala saṃvidam
satyam vedeṣu jāgarti phalam satye param smṛtam
evam punar punar kāryam vajra sūtam milati alam
na ca antaram rūpa guṇam bibharti tathā eva tat dṛśyate rūpam asya
tadā sampadyate brahma tatra eva pralayam gatam
āśrayam sarva bhūtānām manasā iti viśuśruma
ete pāpa kṛtaḥ tāta caranti pṛthivīm imām
mārtāṇḍasya ātmajau etau aṣṭamasya prajāpateḥ
te ca pūrve surāḥ ca iti dvividhāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
śrotum icchāmi kārtsnyena kṛṣṇam avyayam īśvaram
purā aham mṛgayām yātaḥ mārkaṇḍeya āśrame sthitaḥ
yogam me paramam tāta mokṣasya vada bhārata
puruṣebhyaḥ dvijān āhuḥ dvijebhyaḥ mantra vādinaḥ
guṇānām sāmyam āgamya manasā eva manaḥ vaham
tasya mūtra purīṣābhyām sarva lohasya lepanāt
ayam hi api samāhāraḥ śarīra indriya cetasām
ākāśam vāyuḥ ūṣmā ca snehaḥ yat ca api pārthivam
tat hi śrotra āśrayam bhūtam śabdaḥ śrotram samāśritaḥ
svayam tu kurvataḥ tasya jātu mānaḥ bhavet iha
na tu etat anurūpam te yaśasaḥ vā kulasya vā
paryāyeṇa hi bhujyante lokāḥ śakra yadṛcchayā
tat kariṣyāmi te vākyam ṛtam tvam vaktum arhasi
tat eva anubhaviṣyāmi kim me mṛtyuḥ kariṣyati
hasta prāptasya vīrasya tam ca eva puruṣam viduḥ
mokṣyante vāruṇāḥ pāśāḥ tava ime kāla paryayāt
pūrvarūpāṇi me rājan puruṣasya bhaviṣyataḥ
gṛhasthaḥ tu eva sarveṣām caturṇām mūlam ucyate
bhūmeḥ dehaḥ jalāt sāraḥ jyotiṣaḥ cakṣuṣī smṛte
īśaḥ sarvasya bhūtasya sthāvarasya carasya ca
yān tu gandhān rasān vā api brahmacārī na sevate
iti dvau vaṅga jau doṣau dvau ca nāga jau
gṛha dharma rataḥ vidvān dharma nityaḥ jita klamaḥ
āśramāt āśramam sadyas pūtaḥ gacchati karmabhiḥ
lokāḥ tejaḥ mayāḥ tasya pretya ca ānantyam aśnute
na vaktāram punar yānti sa kaivalya āśrame vaset
teṣām bhaya utpādana jāta khedaḥ kuryāt na karmāṇi hi śraddadhānaḥ
patatriṇam pakṣiṇam antarikṣe yaḥ veda bhogya ātmani dīpta raśmiḥ
śabdaḥ śrotram tathā khāni trayam ākāśa saṃbhavam
śmaśru loma ca keśāḥ ca sirāḥ snāyu ca carma ca
uttareṣu guṇāḥ santi sarve sarveṣu ca uttarāḥ
ebhiḥ kāla aṣṭamaiḥ bhāvaiḥ yaḥ sarvaiḥ sarvam anvitam
svapatām jāgratām ca eva sarveṣām ātma cintitam
tatra adahyanta bhūtāni jaṅgamāni dhruvāṇi ca
api pāpa kṛtaḥ raudrāḥ satyam kṛtvā pṛthak pṛthak
na aham pareṣām karmāṇi praśaṃsāmi śapāmi vā
kadā taiḥ sukha saṃvāsaiḥ saha vāsaḥ bhavet mama
samādhānāya cittasya prayatiṣye damāya ca
evam sa gautamaḥ tasya prītaḥ putrasya bhārata
etat prathama kalpena rājā kṛta yuge abhajat
ṛcaḥ yajūṃṣi sāmāni yajamānaḥ ca ṣoḍaśaḥ
evam pakva kaṣāyāṇām ānantyena śrutena ca
vede hi niṣṭhā sarvasya yat yat asti ca na asti ca
eṣā eva niṣṭhā sarvasya yat yat asti ca na asti ca
dharmam artham ca kāmam ca vedāḥ śaṃsanti bhārata
tad artham arjana āyāsaḥ naraka ādiṣu ca vyathā
tasya tena tu bhāvena mṛga hiṃsā ātmanaḥ tadā
vyājena carataḥ dharmam artha vyājaḥ api rocate
vikrīta sva ātma bhāvānām sadā preṣaṇa kāriṇām
dharma ātmā ca eva bhavati mokṣam ca labhate param
maunena bahu bhāṣyam ca śauryeṇa ca bhayam jayet
pāyu upasthau visarga artham indriye tulya karmaṇī
kāmānām upamām yānti naraka ādi vyathā smṛteḥ
tāsām kṣaye viddhi kṛtam visargam saṃhāram ekam ca tathā prajānām
śakrasya ca sura indrasya vṛtrasya ca mahātmanaḥ
tailam granthi ādi rogiṣu śasyate
tūṣṇīṃbhūtā bhavat rājan dahyamānena cetasā
śabda rūpa rasa sparśān saha gandhena kevalān
deva śreṣṭhāya rudrāya saumyāya bahu rūpiṇe
gacchatu eṣa yathākāmam iti rājan punar punar
damena śobhate vipraḥ kṣatriyaḥ vijayena tu
teṣām darpaḥ samabhavat prajānām dharma nāśanaḥ
tasmin hate atha svam bhāvam pratyapadyanta mānavāḥ
rājānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ ca eva maṇḍaleṣu pṛthak pṛthak
sa tvam evaṃvidhaḥ dāntaḥ kṣatriyaḥ priya bāndhavaḥ
etat icchāmi aham śrotum tat brūhi vadatām vara
asya api hi varākasya spardhā kila mayā saha
bhūtānām indriyāṇām ca guṇānām ca samāgamam
bauddham sampad sukham muktvā nā abhaviṣyat iyam daśā
anya adhika yaśaḥ vādaiḥ yaśaḥ asya malinīkuru
kaḥ svid ekaḥ ramate brāhmaṇānām kaḥ svid ekaḥ bahubhiḥ joṣam āste
balasthasya hi yogasya bandhana īśasya pārthiva
nidarśana artham sūkṣmāṇi vakṣyāmi ca punar tava
karoti amalam ātmānam bhāskara upama darśanam
kāmam jitvā tathā krodham śīta uṣṇe varṣam eva ca
yathā yathā asya kāyasya kriyate paripālanam
ete doṣāḥ śarīreṣu dṛśyante sarva dehinām
na ca snehaḥ na ca dveṣaḥ tasmāt sneham karomi kim
rodana aśru mala kṣāram saṅga tyāga parāyaṇam
tatra tān pravahaḥ vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti bhārata
indriyāṇi api budhyante sva deham dehinaḥ nṛpa
yathā ayam puruṣaḥ
anyonyasya abhisaṃbandhāt anyonya guṇa saṃśrayāt
veda śāstra pramāṇam ca pramāṇam tat sanātanam
vargasya vargam ācāram tattvam tattvāt sanātanam
mūtra utsarge purīṣe ca bhojane ca narādhipa
yogam etat hi yogānām manye yogasya lakṣaṇam
adhiṣṭhānāt adhiṣṭhātā kṣetrāṇām iti naḥ śrutam
na tu evam vartamānānām āvṛttiḥ vidyate punar
avyaktam na tu tat brahma budhyate tāta kevalam
dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ iti eṣa rājan vedeṣu paṭhyate
tayoḥ śakalayoḥ madhyam ākāśam akarot prabhuḥ
mayā proktā ānupūrvyeṇa saṃhāram api me śṛṇu
ete pradhānasya guṇāḥ trayaḥ puruṣa sattama
puṣkaram tu anyat eva atra tathā anyat udakam smṛtam
kriyamāṇaiḥ na kampeta yuktasya etat nidarśanam
jaṅghābhyām tu vasūn devān āpnuyāt iti naḥ śrutam
kṛtsna dhāriṇam eva tvām manye gandharva sattama
ratna añjalim athā ekam ca brāhmaṇebhyaḥ dadau tadā
param mokṣasya yat ca api tat me brūhi pitāmaha
jñānam loka uttaram yat ca sarva tyāgaḥ ca karmaṇām

atha adhyātmam
atha prāsāda pṛṣṭha sthaḥ dāntaiḥ ujjvala maṇḍanaiḥ
parama āyuḥ smṛtam teṣām śatam varṣāṇi suvratāḥ
dhyātvā āste tat param jyotiḥ ātmānam viṣṇum avyayam
etat parataram brahma jyotiḥ ānandam uttamam
ulūkaḥ vidyutaḥ ca eva śādvalaḥ hi āśvalāyanaḥ
tīrtha yātrā prasaṅgena svāgatam sūtam abruvan
vaset sa narake ghore kalpa ardham tu na saṃśayaḥ
sa kālaḥ vyavahārāṇām śāstra dṛṣṭaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ
dharma utsukān abhyudaye rogiṇaḥ atha jaḍān api
kāla karma guṇa upetaḥ jagat ādiḥ upāviśat
brūhi iti yuktaḥ api na brūyāt sadyas bandhanam arhati
tat patram upadhā duṣṭaiḥ sākṣi lekhaka kārakaiḥ
anumānāt guruḥ sākṣī sākṣibhyaḥ likhitam guru
dāsa cāraṇa mallānām hasti aśva āyudha jīvinām
atas anyeṣu vivādeṣu tri śatam daṇḍam arhati
tad ardha ardhasya nāśe tu spṛśet putra ādi mastakam
na loha śilpinām agnim salilam na ambu sevinām
mātā pitṛ dvija guru bāla strī rāja ghātinām
upalabhya ātmanā ātmānam cakṣuṣā iva arkam ātma dṛś
tad bhartā tad kṛtam kāryam na anyathā kartum arhati
prakāśam ca krayam kuryāt sādhubhiḥ jñātibhiḥ svakaiḥ
ṛṇam ca kārayet vā api sarvaiḥ eva kṛtam bhavet
mad bhaktaḥ pratibuddha arthaḥ mad prasādena bhūyasā
rāja prasāda labdham ca sarveṣām eva tat samam
kāmāt purīṣam kuryāt ca tasya daṇḍaḥ tu māṣakaḥ
chindyāt aṅgam nṛpaḥ tasya na karoti yathā punar
ṛtvij nyāyena yat labdham etat vidyā dhanam bhṛguḥ
sat bhāga kara śulkam ca garte deyam tathā eva ca
taptavantaḥ tapaḥ ghoram puṇye badarikāśrame
ātmānam atra puruṣaḥ avyavadhānam ekam anvīkṣate pratinivṛtta guṇa pravāhaḥ
sahasra bāhum jaṭilam candra ardha kṛta śekharam
dṛṣṭvā te paramam rūpam nirvṛtāḥ sma sanātana
yajvanām phala daḥ devaḥ vartate asau mad ājñayā
brahmāṇḍāni bhaviṣyanti saha vastubhiḥ ātma gaiḥ
maitryā ca eva ātma tulyeṣu yamena niyamena ca
māyā pāśena badhnāmi paśūn etān sva līlayā

yeṣām tu anta gatam pāpam janānām puṇya karmaṇām
itaratra mahān doṣaḥ putra strī paśu nāśanaḥ
prathamaḥ mahataḥ sargaḥ vijñeyaḥ brahmaṇaḥ tu saḥ
aṣṭamaḥ anugrahaḥ sargaiḥ sāttvikaḥ tāmasaḥ ca yaḥ
sarvam etat ṛtam manye yat mām vadasi keśava
aśvatthaḥ sarva vṛkṣāṇām deva ṛṣīṇām ca nāradaḥ
tvam avyayaḥ śāśvata dharma goptā sanātanaḥ tvam puruṣaḥ mataḥ me
samam sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantam parameśvaram
pramāda mohau tamasaḥ bhavataḥ ajñānam eva ca
tam eva śaraṇam gaccha sarva bhāvena bhārata
sarva guhyatamam bhūyas śṛṇu me paramam vacaḥ
keśava arjunayoḥ puṇyam hṛṣyāmi ca muhur muhur
karavāṇi ca te kāmam brūhi yat te abhikāṅkṣitam
dhruvaḥ te vijayaḥ rājan yasya mantrī hariḥ tava
iti prathamaḥ saṃskāraḥ pāṭasāraṇaḥ
śrutam me karṇa bhīṣmasya dveṣāt kila na yotsyasi
tvayi piṇḍaḥ ca tantuḥ ca dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dṛśyate
śabdena tasya vīrasya siṃhasya iva itare mṛgāḥ
īkṣitṛ prīti jananam śukra aṅgārakayoḥ iva
bhīṣmeṇa yuyudhe vīraḥ tasya ca anucaraiḥ saha
drauṇiḥ duryodhanaḥ ca eva vikarṇaḥ ca tava ātmajaḥ
vivyādha prahasan vīraḥ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti ca abravīt
abhidudrāva vegena droṇasya vadha kāṅkṣayā
yathā asya dṛśyate rūpam kāla antaka yama upamam
svātantrya amuktam ātmānam
vavarṣa śara varṣeṇa dhārābhiḥ iva toyadaḥ
atra ca iyam buddhiḥ
yathā ādi padmam taruṇa arka varṇam rarāja nārāyaṇa nābhi jātam
sarva toya mayaḥ devaḥ yogāt suṣvāpa tatra ha
eṣa dharmaḥ ca dharma jñaḥ vara daḥ sarva kāma daḥ
ayoginaḥ tu atra mūḍhāḥ eva iti tātparyam
tasya vikṣipataḥ cāpam śarān anyān ca muñcataḥ
tatra adbhutam apaśyāma saumadatteḥ parākramam
tatra śabdaḥ mahān āsīt tava teṣām ca bhārata
atra ca yadi kāntaloham na labhyate tadā tīkṣṇāyasam sāraloham ca
tvam eva adya phalam bhuṅkṣva kṛtvā kilbiṣam ātmanā
sa teṣām pravarān yodhān hasti aśva ratha sādinaḥ
saḥ aham tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra yātaḥ vṛkodaraḥ
aham droṇaḥ ca śalyaḥ ca kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
yadā asau niyame akalpaḥ jarayā jāta vepathuḥ
dṛṣṭi pūtam nyaset pādam vastra pūtam pibet jalam
śaktim cikṣepa vegena prāgjyotiṣa gajam prati
yudhiṣṭhiraḥ api kauravyaḥ yamābhyām sahitaḥ prabhuḥ
yudhyatām tu tathā teṣām kurvatām karma duṣkaram
sarva utpatti apyayam brahma kāraṇam mā upayāti saḥ
rākṣasaḥ vyanadat ghoram sa śabdaḥ tumulaḥ abhavat
rākṣasānām ca rāja indra duryodhana balasya ca
saṃśayam paramam prāptaḥ putraḥ te bharata ṛṣabha
caturbhiḥ atha nārācaiḥ āvantyasya mahātmanaḥ
parvatam vāri dhārābhiḥ śaradi iva balāhakāḥ
teṣām ca rakṣaṇa arthāya yudhyate phalgunaḥ paraiḥ
kā titikṣā dhṛtiḥ prabho kim dānam kim tapaḥ śauryam
abhyavartanta vegena bhīmasena purogamāḥ
dadhāra supratīkaḥ api velā iva makara ālayam
etasmin eva kāle tu pāṇḍavaḥ kṛṣṇasārathiḥ
atha śabdaḥ mahān āsīt tava sainyasya bhārata
padma indu dyutibhiḥ ca eva vadanaiḥ cāru kuṇḍalaiḥ
uvāca prāñjaliḥ bhīṣmam bāṣpa kaṇṭhaḥ aśru locanaḥ
abhidudrāva vegena tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti ca abravīt
gurave dakṣiṇām dadyāt yathā vibhava vistaraiḥ
tad ātmatā samāpattiḥ icchataḥ sādhakasya yā
karmaṇā tena pārthasya tutuṣuḥ deva dānavāḥ
bhīṣmam droṇam kṛpam ca eva śalyam ca uvāca bhārata
tam dvādaśa ardhaiḥ nakulaḥ mādhavaḥ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
mādhavaḥ tu vacaḥ śrutvā phalgunasya mahātmanaḥ
gajam nala vanāni iva vimṛdnantam balam mama
jīvitam bahu manye aham jīvitam hi adya durlabham
śayanāni yathāsvāni bhejire puruṣa ṛṣabhāḥ
tam vināśam manuṣya indra nara vāraṇa vājinām
aśaknuvan raṇe jetum pāśa hastam iva antakam
ṛte tvām puruṣa vyāghra deva tulya parākrama
asmin hate hatam manye pāṇḍavānām mahat balam
jāyate kāñcanam divyam niṣekāt bhāskarasya ca
bhīmam vivyādha saptatyā tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti ca abravīt
mad vadhe kriyatām yatnaḥ mama ced icchasi priyam
tat yuddham abhavat ghoram citra rūpam ca bhārata
na jaghāna raṇe bhīṣmaḥ sa ca tam na avabuddhavān
tasya bāṇa sahasrāṇi sṛjataḥ dṛḍha dhanvinaḥ
etasmin eva kāle tu kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ
mṛdyamānāḥ ca dṛśyante pārthena nara yūthapāḥ
tatra āsīt tumulam yuddham tāvakānām paraiḥ saha
dhārayiṣyāmi aham prāṇān uttarāyaṇa kāṅkṣayā
hata pravīrāḥ ca vayam nikṛttāḥ ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
iti sma śara talpa stham bharatānām amadhyamam
janma śayyā gatam devam kārttikeyam iva prabhum
lebhe na śāntim kauravyaḥ cintā śoka parāyaṇaḥ
hantāsmi eka rathena eva kṛtsnān yān manyase rathān
na tu eva aham na gamiṣyāmi teṣām madhye śūrāṇām tat tathā aham bravīmi
adya gāṇḍīva muktānām aśanīnām iva svanaḥ
ambaṣṭhāḥ ca videhāḥ ca gāndhārāḥ ca jitāḥ tvayā
yuktam duryodhana anarthe sṛṣṭam droṇa vadhāya ca
nāmabhiḥ tu samākhyātāḥ nāradena mahātmanā
manasā api hi durdharṣau senām etām yaśasvinau
madhye sarvasya sainyasya putram te vākyam abravīt
karṇe bandham manuṣyasya tṛtīya jvara nāśanam
yojanānām śatam gacchet śramaḥ tasya na jāyate
tam jayantam anīkāni tāni tāni eva bhārata
bhūtānām trāsa jananam cakrāte astra viśāradau
cakrāte ati adbhutam yuddham paraspara vadha eṣiṇau
nirviśeṣam abhūt yuddham tayoḥ puruṣa siṃhayoḥ
tvadīyaiḥ pāṇḍu putrāṇām devānām iva dānavaiḥ
hate tu puruṣa vyāghre raṇe satyajiti prabho
pattayaḥ chinna varmāṇaḥ kṛpaṇam śerate hatāḥ
etasmin antare ca eva pramatte savyasācini
droṇasya yatamānasya vaśam na eṣyasi suvrata
atha śveta arka kalpaḥ
nirdahantam anīkāni tāni tāni punar punar
droṇam matsyāt avarajaḥ śatānīkaḥ abhyavartata
katham syāt avaśeṣam hi dhuryayoḥ abhyatītayoḥ
etat devi sadā pathyam apathyam varjayet sadā
rājānam pāṇḍava śreṣṭham dharma ātmānam yudhiṣṭhiram
lavaṇa amlam ca śākam ca vidagdha annam ca varjayet
sa saṃprahāraḥ tumulaḥ tayoḥ puruṣa siṃhayoḥ
tasya nāgam maṇi mayam ratna citram dhvaje sthitam
dṛṣṭvā tat karma pārthasya vāsavasya iva mādhavaḥ
akampanīyāḥ śatrūṇām babhūvuḥ tatra pāṇḍavāḥ
ayasām iva saṃpātaḥ śilānām iva ca abhavat
tasya droṇaḥ śitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ tīkṣṇa dhāraiḥ ayasmayaiḥ
ślāghamāneṣu bhūteṣu phalgunasya amitān guṇān
śrotum icchāmi kārtsnyena katham āyodhane hataḥ
śubha nakṣatra saṃyoge sūtena saha mardayet
evam te bhāṣamāṇasya balam saubhadra vardhatām
tapta kāñcana varṇa ābhaḥ dvis aṣṭa varṣam ākṛtiḥ
asau aham amutra iti pravadantaḥ muhur muhur
jaghāna ca asya anucarān gāndhārān saptasaptatim
ekaḥ ayam nihataḥ śete na eṣa dharmaḥ mataḥ hi naḥ
svargam eṣa gataḥ śūraḥ yaḥ hataḥ na parāṅmukhaḥ
katham drakṣyāmi kaunteyam saubhadre nihate arjunam
vikrama śruta māhātmyaiḥ katham āyodhane hataḥ
gataḥ puṇya kṛtām lokān abhimanyuḥ na saṃśayaḥ
etat ca sarva vīrāṇām kāṅkṣitam bharata ṛṣabha
dharma kṛdbhiḥ kṛtaḥ dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇām raṇe kṣayaḥ
uktavantaḥ sma te tāta bhinddhi anīkam iti prabho
guru dāra gāminām ye ca piśunānām ca ye tathā
droṇena saha putreṇa vīreṇa yadi manyase
sadṛśam maraṇam hi etat tava putrasya mā śucaḥ
gataḥ puṇya kṛtām lokān sarva kāmaduhaḥ akṣayān
tam ajam kāraṇa ātmānam jagmatuḥ śaraṇam bhavam
mālyam ca jala kumbhān ca jvalitam ca hutāśanam
jagmatuḥ sahitau vīrau arjunasya niveśanam
guṇa doṣa bhidā dṛṣṭim antareṇa vacaḥ tava
abhimanyau hate tatra ke vā ayudhyanta māmakāḥ
anyeṣām ca sutānām me na tathā śrūyate dhvaniḥ
saumadattim śruta nidhim teṣām na śrūyate dhvaniḥ
anyaḥ duryodhanāt karṇāt śakuneḥ ca api saubalāt
na imam lokam ca kāṅkṣeta deha āveśāt pramādyati
nārāyaṇāḥ ca gopālāḥ kāmbojānām ca ye gaṇāḥ
sa tu pārtham tribhiḥ viddhvā siṃhanādam atha anadat
kṣemam vindanti mat sthānam yat brahma paramam viduḥ
gaja aśva sādi mlecchānām patitānām śataiḥ śaraiḥ
sarvam hi adya āturam manye na etat asti balam mama
sārathiḥ pravaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śīghrāḥ ca asya haya uttamāḥ
senā mukhe ca pārthānām etat balam upasthitam
tam katham pāṇḍavam yuddhe dahantam ahitān bahūn
guṇa doṣa artha niyamaḥ tad bhidām eva bādhate
dadṛśuḥ sarva bhūtāni śakra jambhau yathā purā
vividhaiḥ vismayam jagmuḥ tayoḥ puruṣa siṃhayoḥ
astre te vāruṇa āgneye tābhyām bāṇa samāhite
ratham ratha varasya ājau yuktam labdha udakaiḥ hayaiḥ
tam tathā iti abravīt pārthaḥ kṛtya rūpam idam mama
tayoḥ samīpam samprāpya putraḥ te bharata ṛṣabha
ekaḥ droṇaḥ hi veda etat aham tasmāt ca sattamāt

satyāḥ vivādaḥ ca tathā dakṣa śāpaḥ tathā eva ca
parāśarasya ca utpattiḥ vyāsasya ca mahātmanaḥ
pāṇḍavānām ca bhadram te sṛñjayānām ca sarvaśas
saḥ aham bhāram samādhāsye tvayi tam voḍhum arhasi
sāhāyye viniyokṣyāmi nā asti me anyaḥ hi tad samaḥ
devānām vara dānam ca śukrasya ca visarjanam
kāraṇa dvayam etat hi jānānaḥ tvā aham abruvam
devasya āgamanam ca eva vṛttasya kathanam tathā
nigrahaḥ ca andhakasya atha yuddhena mahatā tathā
bhasma soma udbhavaḥ ca eva śmaśāna vasatiḥ tathā
madhye sarvasya sainyasya vāsudevasya śṛṇvataḥ
yaḥ pratīyāt raṇe droṇam yāvat gacchāmi pāṇḍavam
pratijñām ātmanaḥ rakṣan satyām kartum ca bhārata
prahlāda vigrahaḥ ca eva kṛtaghna ākhyānam eva ca
priye hi tava vartete bhrātarau kṛṣṇa pāṇḍavau
ekena sārathim ca asya caturbhiḥ caturaḥ hayān
yām śrutvā yoginaḥ dhyānāt prapadyante maheśvaram
anvadhāvat raṇe yattaḥ yuyudhānam yuyutsayā
palāyamānān ca kurūn manye śocanti putrakāḥ
kṣaṇena dṛṣṭvā tau vīrau manye śocanti putrakāḥ
ātma aparādhāt sambhūtam vyasanam bharata ṛṣabha
sarva lokasya tattva jñaḥ sarva loka guruḥ prabhuḥ
rudraḥ sraṣṭā hi sarveṣām bhūtānām tava ca prabho
sarveṣām manasi sadā avatiṣṭhamānaḥ jānānaḥ śubham aśubham ca bhūtanāthaḥ
sṛṣṭi artham bhūyas eva atha tapaḥ cartum pracakrame
vyāpya iva hi jagat kṛtsnam parameṇa sva tejasā
ke tvām yudhi parākrāntam kāla antaka yama upamam
adya mad bāṇa nihatān yodha mukhyān sahasraśas
mayā dattāni tasya āśu upasthāsyanti sarvaśas
yatra eṣa śabdaḥ tumulaḥ tatra sūta ratham naya
tathā evam vadataḥ tasya bhāradvājasya māriṣa
viṣayaḥ sarit samudra ādiḥ
prajāḥ dhārayataḥ yogāt asmin kalpe upasthite
tvac indriya mātra grāhyaḥ guṇaḥ sparśaḥ
te dvividhe diś kṛte kāla kṛte ca
śrotra grāhyaḥ guṇaḥ śabdaḥ
asādhāraṇam kāraṇam karaṇam
tad ubhaya bhinnam kāraṇam nimitta kāraṇam
yakṣāṇām asurāṇām ca ye ca kutra pravartakāḥ
yudhi phalguna bāṇānām sūrya agni sama tejasām
asṛjat viśikhān tīkṣṇān kekayasya ratham prati
lubdhaḥ ayam kṣatriyān hanti vyāghraḥ kṣudra mṛgān iva
bhīmaḥ kariṣyate pūjām iti uvāca vṛkodaram
na arjunaḥ aham ghṛṇī droṇa bhīmasenaḥ asmi te ripuḥ
putrāṇām tava vīrāṇām yudhyatām avadhīt punar
dharmaḥ ca vyavahāraḥ ca caritram rāja śāsanam
santi ca anye durātmānaḥ kūṭa lekhya kṛtaḥ janāḥ
rathena yattaḥ kaunteyaḥ vegena prayayau tadā
rathinām sādinām ca eva tayoḥ śrutvā tala svanam
uvāca ca eva tau vedaḥ na etat evam iti prabhuḥ
jaghāna caturaḥ ca aśvān sūtam ca tvaritaḥ śaraiḥ
ati adbhutam aham manye bhīmasenasya vikramam
ṛṇam deyam adeyam ca yena yatra yathā ca yat
pituḥ eva niyogāt yat kuṭumba bharaṇāya ca
kule jyeṣṭhaḥ tathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakṛti sthaḥ ca yaḥ bhavet
sarveṣām eva varṇānām eṣa dharmyaḥ dhana āgamaḥ
tasyām eva tu yaḥ vṛttau brāhmaṇaḥ ramate rasāt
brāhmaṇasya tu vikreyam śuṣkam dāru tṛṇāni ca
indriya artha viśeṣāya tathā niyama kāriṇe
madīyaḥ gaṇapaḥ yaḥ te mad mūrtiḥ ca bhaviṣyati
sa prāpya paramam jñānam mūḍha tvā vinayiṣyati
vṛthā tad antaram te syāt kuryāḥ ced satyam anyathā
tudantau viśikhaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ matta vāraṇa vikramau
yat gatam tat gatam iti mama āsīt manasi sthitam
gajābhyām samprayuktābhyām āsīt naḍavanam yathā
ucitaḥ tvam vane bhīma na tvam yuddha viśāradaḥ
ratha sthayoḥ dvayoḥ yuddhe kruddhayoḥ yodha mukhyayoḥ
paśya vṛṣṇi andhaka vyāghram saumadatti vaśam gatam
astram rudreṇa vā pārtha droṇena atha kṛpeṇa vā
dhvajāḥ chatrāṇi cāpāni cāmarāṇi śirāṃsi ca
abravīt pāṇḍavam tatra tvaramāṇaḥ janārdanaḥ
bhūyas sphuṭataraḥ bhāti sva bala udyoga bhāvitaḥ
sā tathā uktā viniścitya dṛṣṭvā divyena cakṣuṣā
yadi deśe ca kāle ca svāminaḥ svasya śaṃsati
droṇaputreṇa nihatān rākṣasān ca sahasraśas
tvadīyānām pareṣām ca ghoram vijaya kāṅkṣiṇām
patiḥ kurūṇām gaja siṃha gāmī viśāla vakṣāḥ pṛthu lohita akṣaḥ
vyāla yajñopavītāya kuṇḍala ābharaṇāya ca
bhrātaraḥ ca asya balinaḥ sarva astreṣu kṛta śramāḥ
namaḥ parvata vāsāya śiraḥ hartre ca me purā
vara dāya variṣṭhāya śmaśāna rataye namaḥ
jayet etān raṇe kaḥ nu śakra tulya balaḥ api ariḥ
brahmaṇi atha evam stuvati devadevaḥ sa lokapaḥ
eṣa mūlam hi anarthānām duryodhana mate sthitaḥ
uvāca tuṣṭaḥ tān devān ṛṣīn ca tapasā edhitān
adya mad bāṇa jālāni vimuktāni sahasraśas
vayam śeṣān haniṣyāmaḥ tvayā eva parirakṣitāḥ
jīvatsu pāṇḍu putreṣu tat hi satyam bravīmi te
ātma artham yudhyamānāḥ te samarthāḥ pāṇḍu nandanāḥ
puṇyam pavitram sthānam vai bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
anukramāt trayasya asya kālaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ
etena eva prakāreṇa madhyamam sāhasam smṛtam
vadhāt ṛte brāhmaṇasya na vadham brāhmaṇaḥ arhati
jāyasva duhitā bhūtvā patim rudram avāpsyasi
tathā eva tava putrasya ratha udārāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
mahatā śara varṣeṇa yuyudhānam upādravan
anyāḥ sṛjasva bhadram te prajāḥ mṛtyu samanvitāḥ
ślāghyām ca eva api aduṣṭām ca śreṣṭhām mām garhase pitar
asatkṛtāyāḥ kim me adya jīvitena aśubhena ha
eṣa tvā adya haniṣyāmi mahiṣam skanda rāj iva
tam abhidrutya rādheyaḥ muhūrtāt bharata ṛṣabha
utpatsyante punar yajñe tava jāmātaraḥ tu ime
bhāgam ca tava yajñeṣu dattvā sarve dvijātayaḥ
bhallena anyena tu punar suvarṇa ujjvala kuṇḍalam
pāṇḍavānām raṇe yodhāḥ para lokam tathā apare
na anyena tapasā putra na tīrthānām phalena ca
upari upari ca anyonyam catur aṅgam mamarda ha
pāvaka ambunidhī bhūtvā punar garuḍa takṣakau
kuṇḍale bāla sūrya ābhe mālām hema mayīm śubhām
gaja sthaiḥ ca ratha sthaiḥ ca vāji pṛṣṭha gataiḥ tathā
cukruśuḥ na idam asti iti droṇa drauṇi kṛpa ādayaḥ
atīva tat citram atīva rūpam babhūva yuddham ravi bhīma sūnvoḥ
vṛṣṭim viśālām jvalitām patantīm karṇaḥ śara oghaiḥ na śaśāka hantum
tathā etat lāghavam manye tava karma janārdana
sa bhartā tava deveśaḥ bhavitā mā tapaḥ kṛthāḥ
vadha artham tasya jātaḥ aham anyeṣām ca suradviṣām
ācāryam ye ca te arakṣan duryodhana purogamāḥ
alpe ca kāraṇe kṛṣṇa hataḥ gāṇḍīvadhanvanā
aśva pṛṣṭheṣu ca api anye rathanīḍeṣu ca apare
tasmāt tvam jarayā tyaktaḥ amaraḥ sambhaviṣyasi
tri bhāga mātra śeṣāyām rātryām yuddham avartata
yatra tatra mṛtaḥ ca api brahma lokam gamiṣyati
sa devyāḥ tapasā yuktaḥ mahāgaṇapatiḥ bhavet
śaṅkha bherī mṛdaṅgānām kuñjarāṇām ca garjatām
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti nakulaḥ babhāṣe tanayam tava
ati pāṇḍavam ācāryaḥ droṇam ca api ati pāṇḍavaḥ
droṇa karṇa antara gatam kṛpasya api ca bhārata
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti na ca te svayam tatra avatasthire
grastam ācārya putreṇa kruddhena hata bandhunā
kṣatriyasya hi ayam dharmaḥ hanyāt hanyeta vā punar
yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ca bhīmaḥ ca yamau kṛṣṇaḥ tathā apare
na ca eva mūrkha dharmeṇa kevalena eva śakyate
na tvām vakṣyāmi paruṣam haniṣye tvām vadha kṣamam
devyā jijñāsayā śambhuḥ bhūtvā pañcaśikhaḥ śiśuḥ
aśvatthāmā tathā uktaḥ tu tava putreṇa māriṣa
cintayitvā tu rāja indra dhyāna śoka parāyaṇaḥ
te yuddham na abhinandanti tat tubhyam tāta rocatām
prasādāt tava deveśa niyogāt ca mayā prajāḥ
deva mānuṣayoḥ śaktyā tejasā ca eva pāṇḍavān
jāmadagnyaḥ ca rāmaḥ naḥ kathām akathayat purā
pitāmahaḥ ca droṇaḥ ca kṛpaḥ śalyaḥ śalaḥ tathā
uvāca kāle durdharṣaḥ vāsudevasya śṛṇvataḥ
ātmanaḥ ca pareṣām ca pāṇḍavānām ca niścayam
kartāram akṛtam devam bhūtānām prabhava apyayam
ariṣṭa nemim garuḍam suparṇam patim prajānām bhuvanasya dhāma
śāstra nityaḥ punar dharmam tasya hrīḥ aṅgam uttamam
ekaḥ hi api bahūn hanti ghnanti ekam bahavaḥ api uta
parājayaḥ ca maraṇāt manye nā eva viśiṣyate
prakṛtim te bhajiṣyanti naṣṭa prakṛtayaḥ janāḥ
bruvataḥ tatra me vākyam dharma artha sahitam hitam
asurāṇām samṛddhānām jvalatām iva tejasā
sarva lokāt abhikruddhāt na bhayam vidyate mama
tat idam bhāṣitam vākyam tathā ca na tathā eva ca
kurvanti teṣām karmāṇi yeṣām na asti phala udayaḥ
asmākam api vārṣṇeya vane vicaratām tadā
brahma deva ṛṣayaḥ ca eva kṛṣṇam yadu sukha āvaham
etat mahat prekṣaṇīyam draṣṭum gacchāma keśava
tava vākyāni divyāni tatra teṣām ca mādhava
tāni api asmai pradāsyāmi yāvat arhati keśavaḥ
jānāmi te matam rājan gūḍham bāhyena karmaṇā
yat āha viduraḥ kṛṣṇe sarvam tat satyam ucyate
pāpasya asya nṛśaṃsasya tyakta dharmasya durmateḥ
priya darśanaḥ dīrgha bhujaḥ katham kṛṣṇa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yaḥ apāśrayaḥ pāṇḍavānām devānām iva vāsavaḥ
tathā śokāya bhavati yathā putraiḥ vinābhavaḥ
jvalanam ca svayam kṛtvā kṛtāñjalim upasthitam
teṣām samupaviṣṭānām sarveṣām pāpa cetasām
tat samartham śubham vākyam dharma artha sahitam hitam
atha duryodhanaḥ kṛṣṇam śakuniḥ ca api saubalaḥ
piṇḍe tu patite devi gardabhaḥ api vimucyate
teṣu tatra upaviṣṭeṣu gṛhīta argheṣu bhārata
yadi muktiḥ bhaga kṣobhe kim na muñcanti gardabhāḥ
naraḥ nārāyaṇaḥ ca eva tāpasau iti naḥ śrutam
vikrame gamane bhāre na eṣām asti pariśramaḥ
darśanāt sparśanāt tasya bhakṣaṇāt smaraṇāt api
viṣṇuḥ uvāca
tat alam te virodhena śamam gaccha nṛpa ātmaja
suhṛdām kleśa dātāram dviṣatām harṣa vardhanam
na āste na śete na āhāram kurute gālavaḥ tadā
saḥ aham pāpaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ ca kṛpaṇaḥ ca anṛtaḥ api ca
tasya nā asti priye siddhiḥ janma koṭi śataiḥ api
abhedyam bhāskareṇa api svayam vā kṛṣṇavartmanā
ākāśe tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti tasthau sūryasya śāsanāt
atra jyotīṃṣi sarvāṇi viśanti āditya maṇḍalam
sa yāti niṣphalam karma svapna labdham dhanam yathā
evam bahu ca dīnam ca bruvāṇam gālavam tadā
atha āha gālavam dīnam suparṇaḥ patatām varaḥ
atha vṛtte vivāhe tu bhavasya amita tejasaḥ
namaḥ parvata liṅgāya parvata īśāya vai namaḥ
namaḥ sahasra netrāya sahasra caraṇāya ca
kriyatām mama saṃhāraḥ guru artham dvijasattama
namaḥ veda rahasyāya vedāṅgāya namaḥ namaḥ
namaḥ astu kāla kālāya tṛtīya nayanāya ca
varān utkramya sarvān tān vanam vṛtavatī varam
salile tapyamānāya yoga aiśvarya pradāya ca
tam āhuḥ pārthivāḥ sarve pratimānam iva śriyaḥ
sarveṣām naḥ kratu phalam dharmaḥ ca pratigṛhyatām
namaḥ anugraha kartre ca sthiti kartre namaḥ namaḥ
prāptavān asmi yat loke kṣatra dharma udbhavam yaśaḥ
yathā prāṇān ca rājyam ca rājan karma sukhāni ca
yathā satyena me dharmaḥ yathā satyena pāvakaḥ
prītaḥ śakraḥ ca satyena tena satyena kham vraja
na hi tvām utsahe vaktum bhūyas bharata sattama
na sa labhyaḥ punar jātu mayi jīvati keśava
kaṃsam ekam parityajya kula arthe sarva yādavāḥ
deva asura manuṣyāḥ ca gandharva uraga rākṣasāḥ
kāmam krodham ca lobham ca dambham darpam ca bhūmipaḥ
na lobhāt artha saṃpattiḥ narāṇām iha dṛśyate
pāṇḍava arthe hi lubhyantaḥ svārthāt hāsyanti te sutāḥ
devaiḥ manuṣyaiḥ gandharvaiḥ asuraiḥ uragaiḥ ca yaḥ
iha eva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve tathā eva andhaka vṛṣṇayaḥ
deva dundubhayaḥ neduḥ puṣpa varṣam papāta ca
padma ākāram mukham yasyāḥ dṛṣṭiḥ indīvara ākṛtiḥ
ṛṣibhiḥ ca mayā ca eva na ca asau tat gṛhītavān
sa loke labhate kīrtim paratra ca śubhām gatim
na eva samprāpnuvanti tvām mumūrṣum iva bheṣajam
bhīma arjunau nayetām hi devān api parām gatim
ogha megha svanaḥ kāle yat kṛṣṇaḥ karṇam abravīt
yat abruvam aham kṛṣṇa kaṭukāni sma pāṇḍavān
api tvām na tapet karṇa rājya lābha upapādanā
dhārtarāṣṭrasya sainyeṣu tat parābhava lakṣaṇam
śrutvā tu kuntī tat vākyam artha kāmena bhāṣitam
tathyam pathyam hitam ca uktaḥ na ca gṛhṇāti durmatiḥ
duryodhana nibodha idam yat tvām vakṣyāmi putraka
yavīyāṃsaḥ abhijāyante rājyam vṛddha upasevayā
atha praśna avatārāya pūrva uktam rasabhairavam
kekayaiḥ vṛṣṇibhiḥ ca eva pārthivaiḥ śataśas vṛtam
yuyudhānaḥ ca vikrāntaḥ devaiḥ api durāsadaḥ
bhīmasena arjunau ca eva dāśārhasya mate sthitau
ajātaśatruḥ api adya bhīma arjuna vaśa anugaḥ
dhuryayoḥ hayayoḥ ekaḥ tathā anyau pārṣṇisārathī
tau ca api rathinām śreṣṭhau rathī ca haya vid tathā
sarvatra svāhā antam
gate rāme tīrthayātrām bhīṣmakasya sute tathā
rasāṅkuśena mantreṇa kartavyam sādhakena tu
na bhayāt vāsudevasya na ca api tava phalguna
yadā ca niścalam dhyāyet yadā ca niścalam manaḥ
kriyā karaṇa vighnāḥ ca phala vighnāḥ ca koṭiśas
satyam bravīmi aham hi etat sarvam satyam bhaviṣyati
ulūkasya vacaḥ śrutvā kuntī putraḥ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
bahūni iha sahasrāṇi prayutāni arbudāni ca
rathau tau ratha śārdūla matau me ratha sattamau
rathaḥ mama mataḥ tāta dṛḍha vega parākramaḥ
doṣaḥ tu asya mahān ekaḥ yena eṣa bharata ṛṣabha
bhūyas ca śrotum icchāmi pareṣām ratha sattamān
etat śrutvā tu bhīṣmasya rājñām dadhvaṃsire tadā
tena asau ratha vaṃśena mahat karma kariṣyati
sametāḥ pāṇḍavasya arthe vāsudeva purogamāḥ
aśarīraḥ api te kāle kāryam sarvam kariṣyati
gaccha gaccha iti tām śālvaḥ punar punar abhāṣata
ambāyāḥ tām kathām śrutvā kāśi rājñaḥ ca bhārata
namaḥ trailokya liṅgāya dāha liṅgāya vai namaḥ
dharmam prati vacaḥ brūyāḥ śṛṇu ca idam vacaḥ mama
ambā uvāca
na hi te vidyate śāntiḥ anyathā kuru nandana
yā tvām ajījanat mandam yuddha kāmukam āturam
badhāna samare rāma yadi yoddhum mayā icchasi
evam etat kuru śreṣṭha kartavyam bhūtim icchatā
tān aham niśitaiḥ bhallaiḥ śataśas atha sahasraśas
na ca rāmaḥ kṣayam gantā tena astreṇa narādhipa
jāne sarva upayogam ca jāne ca aduṣṭa tām tava
sahasram rathinām ekam eṣa bhāgaḥ mataḥ mama
ācārya kena kālena pāṇḍu putrasya sainikān
na hi tāvat raṇe pārtham bāṇa khaḍga dhanuḥ dharam
cedi kāśi karūṣāṇām netāram dṛḍha vikramam
bhīmasenam ca durdharṣam prathamam prādiśat balam
dakṣa nārada mukhyaiḥ tu yuktam tvām katham uktavān
sāram brūhi iti papracchuḥ brahmāṇam brahma loka gam
śṛṇu rudra pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā ca suraiḥ saha
atha śuśrāva vedānām dhvanim ekasya su svaram
adhīyānasya tatra āśu dhyānam eva anvapadyata
kaupīna ācchādana arthe vāsaḥ bibhṛyāt
dakṣa putra sahasram ca teṣu naṣṭeṣu sṛṣṭavān
nāradaḥ hi abhavat putraḥ kaśyapasya muneḥ punar
tābhyām putra sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiḥ dānava sattamāḥ
nitya svādhyāyaḥ
gṛha devatābhyaḥ praviśya
kṣetrapālāya namaḥ
yājana adhyāpana pratigrahāḥ sarveṣām
catvāri vedavratāni
karma kartā ca karma eva kriyā kāryam tathā eva ca
vanaspatīnām ca patiḥ anilasya patiḥ tathā
saritām ca patiḥ ca eva samudrāṇām patiḥ tathā
kāraṇam mahataḥ ca eva pradhānasya ca kāraṇam
nadānām kāraṇam ca eva nadīnām kāraṇam param
gandhasya parama ātmā ca rūpasya ātmā paraḥ tathā
upasthasya tathā eva ātmā pāyu ātmā paramaḥ tathā
yājñavalkyaḥ devalaḥ ca vyāsaḥ ca eva parāśaraḥ
śaraṇyaḥ ca eva nityaḥ ca buddhaḥ muktaḥ śarīra bhṛt
dhanī dhana pradaḥ dhanyaḥ yādavānām hite rataḥ
nārāt ca āvasathāt
na śiśna udara pāṇi pāda vāc cakṣuḥ cāpalāni kuryāt
satya dharmā
ārya vṛttiḥ

sarve mala harāḥ kṣārāḥ sarve ca amlāḥ prabodhakāḥ
śūraḥ ca kṛta vidyaḥ ca pūrvaiḥ tulyaḥ asi tejasā
bhasma rāśīkṛtāḥ yatra pitaraḥ tasya sāgarāḥ
salile puruṣa vyāghra śuciḥ puṇya phalaḥ bhava
petatuḥ vṛṣaṇau bhūmau sahasrākṣasya tad kṣaṇāt
gaja siṃha gatī vīrau śārdūla vṛṣabha upamau
śatānandaḥ muni śreṣṭham viśvāmitram atha abravīt
vasiṣṭhasya āśrama padam brahma lokam iva aparam
evam uktaḥ vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitraḥ mahāmatiḥ
evam bruvantam rājānam vasiṣṭhaḥ punar eva hi
yaiḥ tat tapaḥ vanam sarvam nirdagdham ca astra tejasā
brahmāstram grasamānasya vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ
atha asya jajñire putrāḥ satya dharma parāyaṇāḥ
analaḥ dāruṇaḥ vahniḥ pāvakaḥ śabalaḥ tathā
tad cūrṇa yukta tailasya lepāt śuklāḥ bhavanti hi
guru śāpa kṛtam rūpam yat idam tvayi vartate
ayam ikṣvāku dāyādaḥ triśaṅkuḥ iti viśrutaḥ
jagmuḥ yathāgatam sarve yajñasya ante narottama
yā ca ādyā paramā vidyā cāmuṇḍā kālikā parā
asya jīvita mātreṇa priyam kuruta putrakāḥ
tām uvāca sahasrākṣaḥ vepamānām kṛta añjalim
varjayitvā muni varam rājānam tau ca rāghavau
mama satyā pratijñā ca vīrya śulkā iti kauśika
dakṣa netre cumbane ca bhāskara grahaṇam tadā
purā eva kathitam sarvam bahu kim kathyate adhunā
etat tattvam prayatnena brahmā jānāti mādhavaḥ
ārādhanam kīdṛśam vā tat vadasva dayā nidhe
guṇaiḥ ebhiḥ samuditaḥ sevate yaḥ rasāyanam
tat alam te vanam gatvā kṣamam na hi vanam tava
vana vāsa nimittāya bhartāram idam abravīt
atha mām evam avyagrām vanam nā eva nayiṣyasi
idānīm yajña sūtrasya vidhānam mayi kathyatām
tathā vastram pradātavyam sarva kalyāṇa hetave
hanti bhakṣaṇa mātreṇa pūrva janma agha sambhavam
mukham drakṣyāmi rāmasya durdarśam naḥ bhaviṣyati
tailam prāvṛṣi śasyate iti sambandhaḥ
na sūryaḥ tapate lokam sarvam paryākulam jagat
tad annasya ca dānena kṣiti dāna phalam labhet
aham kim ca api vakṣyāmi devīm tava sutaḥ mayā
aśobhetām ṛṣi samau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
ekā eva hi mahāvidyā nāma mātram pṛthak pṛthak
dehasya bhavataḥ prāyas bhauma āpyam itarat ca te
tṛtīyam malam āha
vipra rūpeṇa devena prema bhāvena cetasā
madhuraḥ ca amla pākaḥ ca vrīhiḥ pitta karaḥ guruḥ
kuje vā śanivāre vā prathame gamanam caret
saḥ atyanta sukhitaḥ sūta kim aśiṣyati rāghavaḥ
katham nara vara śreṣṭha putrau tau saha sītayā
amanāḥ tena śokena rāma śokena ca prabhuḥ
evam tvam putra śokena rājan kālam kariṣyasi
nikumbha ādīni etāni virecanāni
tasyāḥ samīpe tu nalam praśaśaṃsuḥ kutūhalāt
katham āgamanam ca iha katham ca asi na lakṣitaḥ
kumbhaḥ trivṛt
ruci kṛt pācanaḥ hṛdyaḥ śūla ghnaḥ gulma nāśanaḥ
na etat asti
sarvam tat tava viśrabdham kuru praṇayam īśvara
tena satyena me devāḥ tam eva pradiśantu me
dravyam iti anuvartate
evam lavaṇa ādīnām api vedyam
prathamam ekam gṛham tasya abhyantare dvitīyam tasya abhyantare tṛtīyam evam tri garbhā
dravyam hi guru ādīnām iva rasānām api āśrayaḥ
tena eva ca dugdhena māsam ekam varteta
dāru devadāru
jīmūte śuci rūpam syāt kare pāṭala bhāsuram
naraḥ yānena yaḥ svapne khara yuktena yāti hi
evam āpi ādiṣu sarvam yojyam
guru ādi guṇa utkaṭam gaurava ādi karam ca pārthivam dravyam
rūkṣa ādi guṇa utkaṭam dāha ādi karam ca dravyam āgneyam
dīpanaḥ gulma hāraḥ ca vāta śleṣma apakarṣa kṛt
tathā anila ātmakam grāhi
tam aham draṣṭum icchāmi bharatam dīrgha darśinam
teṣu ca aparihāryeṣu na evam bhavitum arhati
cira sthitam laghu svaccham pathyam svādu sukha āvaham
puṇḍraḥ ati madhuraḥ śītaḥ kapha kṛt pitta nāśanaḥ
samīpa stham uvāca idam sumantram mantra kovidam
bharataḥ sacivān sarvān abravīt vākya kovidaḥ
evam asmābhiḥ uktena lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
teṣām pitta vighāte tikta kaṣāyau katham bhavataḥ
tayoḥ yāni punar uktāni tāni dviguṇam yojyāni
tvam mām evam gatam matvā prasādam kartum arhasi
surā ādīni ca peyāni māṃsāni vividhāni ca
śaila prastheṣu ramyeṣu paśya imān kāma harṣaṇān
sadyas anyathā tat kurute prabhāvāt hetoḥ atas tasya na gocaraḥ asti
tat evam dravyāṇām dvaividhyam
bhīma stanita gambhīraḥ tumulaḥ śrūyate svanaḥ
dravya ādīnām prabhāva antānām
lavaṇam saindhavam na uṣṇam amlam āmalakam yathā
virūpam api yoddhāram bhṛtyam icchanti pārthivāḥ
śūram aiśvarya kāmam ca yaḥ na hanti sa vadhyate
yathā ukta vādī dūtaḥ te kṛtaḥ bharata paṇḍitaḥ
brāhmam tapaḥ brahmacaryam adhyātma dhyānam eva ca
dvijāteḥ divya bhāvaḥ ca sadā nirvāṇa dāyakaḥ
pituḥ cakāra tejasvī nivāpam bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
prasāda bhogī yaḥ devi sa paśuḥ na atra saṃśayaḥ
saṃskāraḥ hi guṇa antara ādhānam ucyate
tāḥ pāṇibhiḥ sukha sparśaiḥ mṛdu aṅguli talaiḥ śubhaiḥ
okāt iti abhyāsāt
evam narasya jātasya na anyatra maraṇāt bhayam
uvāca bharataḥ citram dhārmikaḥ dhārmikam vacaḥ
annasya upadravam paśya mṛtaḥ hi kim aśiṣyati
vedāḥ satya pratiṣṭhānāḥ tasmāt satya paraḥ bhavet
setum satyasya bhetsyāmi guroḥ satya pratiśravaḥ
śīghragasya maruḥ putraḥ maroḥ putraḥ praśuśrukaḥ
jñātayaḥ ca hi yodhāḥ ca mitrāṇi suhṛdaḥ ca naḥ
rājyam ca idam ayodhyām ca dhūta pāpaḥ bhavāmi ca
avidyā kṣetram uttareṣām prasupta tanu vicchinna udārāṇām
samānam pūrveṇa iti pūrva yoga phala śrutyā etat api yuktam iti arthaḥ
gamyatām anujānāmi rāmasya anucarī bhava
viśālaiḥ agni śaraṇaiḥ sruc bhāṇḍaiḥ ajinaiḥ kuśaiḥ
mūlam puṣpam phalam vanyam āśramam ca mahātmanaḥ
kṛta ātithyaḥ atha rāmaḥ tu sūryasya udayanam prati
dhvasta vṛkṣa latā gulmam durdarśa salilāśayam
iti bruvati kākutsthe bāṣpa śoka pariplute
rājya kāme mama krodhaḥ bharate yaḥ babhūva ha
cāmara vyajane ca agrye rukma daṇḍe mahādhane
śatam śatam kuṇḍalinaḥ yuvānaḥ khaḍga pāṇayaḥ
vāc rūpiṇī iti tad adhiṣṭhātrī devatā
kriyamāṇam vane ghoram rakṣobhiḥ bhīma karmabhiḥ
mṛtsnam masṛṇam accham svaccham
dāruṇaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇānām gadaiḥ vaivasvata kṣayam
śrotra ākāśayoḥ sambandha saṃyamāt divyam śrotram
tasya idam āśrama padam prabhāvāt yasya rākṣasaiḥ
śītam vīryeṇa yat dravyam madhuram rasa pākayoḥ
te vyakta sūkṣmāḥ guṇa ātmānaḥ
raukṣyāt kaṣāyaḥ rūkṣāṇām uttamaḥ madhyamaḥ kaṭuḥ
sādhāraṇam iti sādhāraṇa kārya yogi tvam
agni samām iti agni anurūpām
yā pāśa bhūtā sarveṣām indriyāṇām paraiḥ guṇaiḥ
uvāca bhrātaram rāmaḥ lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam
bhāva jñena kṛtajñena dharma jñena ca lakṣmaṇa
kṛta abhiṣekaḥ sa rarāja rāmaḥ sītā dvitīyaḥ saha lakṣmaṇena
pūlī napuṃsaka dharmi tvāt
yuktam ṣaṣṭika cūrṇena sarpiṣā abhinavena ca
sarva kāma maye ramye tīre kṣīra payonidheḥ
svarṇa varṇam guru snigdham tanu pattram ca bhāsuram
rasa bandhanam utkṛṣṭam keśa rañjanam uttamam
namane bhaṅguram yat tat khara loham udāhṛtam
tīkṣṇāt lakṣa guṇam kāntam bhakṣaṇāt kurute guṇān
pādam pādam kṣipet bhasma śulbasya vimalasya ca
tat pītam dahane tāmram kharam rūkṣam ghana asaham
eva nitya arcanam tatra kartavyam rasa siddhaye
śucīnām satya vākyānām āstikānām manasvinām
yāvat uṣṇam bhavet sarvam bhājanam tāvat eva hi
khalla pramāṇam tat jñeyam śreṣṭham syāt rasakarmaṇi
phala mūla aśanau dāntau tāpasau dharma cāriṇau
tantra kartuḥ abhiprāyān iti yathā uktam raseṣu guṇa āropaṇe tat boddhavyam
upāyān iti śāstra upāyān tantra yukti rūpān
sa samprahāraḥ tumulaḥ rāma triśirasoḥ mahān
babhūva atīva balinoḥ siṃha kuñjarayoḥ iva
udvejanīyaḥ bhūtānām nṛśaṃsaḥ pāpa karma kṛt
jāta madaḥ kālaḥ vasanta ādiḥ
sukha upabhogān balinām bhūyas ca bala vardhanān
payaḥ anupānāḥ tāḥ śīghram kurvanti vṛṣatām parām
harṣaṇam manasaḥ ca eva sarvam tat vṛṣyam ucyate
abhidhāna pragalbhasya tava pratyaya ghātinī
deva dānava gandharva piśāca pataga uragaiḥ
saktam grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu kāma vṛttam mahīpatim
yeṣām cāraḥ ca kośaḥ ca nayaḥ ca jayatām vara
yajñāt dānāt tapasaḥ veda adhyayanāt damāt sat ācārāt
catur aṅgula vistāram sūkṣma vastram śanais graset
manmathasya śarāṇām ca tvam vidheyaḥ bhaviṣyasi
krīḍā rati vidhi jñābhiḥ apsarobhiḥ sahasraśas
pāṇḍurāṇi viśālāni divya mālya yutāni ca
evam abhyāsa yogena koṣṭha doṣaḥ na vidyate
mūrtīḥ iti vyaktīḥ
kapha doṣāḥ vinaśyanti divya dṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate
vasanti mad niyogena adhivāsam ca rākṣasaḥ
na ca dharma guṇaiḥ hīnaḥ kausalyā ānanda vardhanaḥ
anṛtam na śrutam ca eva na eva tvam vaktum arhasi
rājā sarvasya lokasya devānām iva vāsavaḥ
dṛṣṭaḥ ced tvam raṇe tena tad antam tava jīvitam
viparyaye tu tat sarvam vyartham bhavati rāvaṇa
vīryam iti śaktiḥ
samāpta vana vāsānām rājya sthānām ca naḥ punar
uvāca rāghavaḥ hṛṣṭaḥ bhrātaram lakṣmaṇam vacaḥ
hriyamāṇām na jānīṣe rakṣasā kāmarūpiṇā
sarvāṇi śaraṇam yāmi mṛga pakṣi gaṇān api
pāpa svabhāvaḥ capalaḥ katham tvam rakṣasām vara
ṣaṣṭi varṣa sahasrāṇi mama jātasya rāvaṇa
kim nu śakyam mayā kartum gatau dūram nṛpa ātmajau
tasya snehaḥ ati snigdhaḥ ca vāta ghnaḥ sthira dīpti daḥ
dadarśa gṛdhram patitam samīpe rāghava āśramāt
paramam khalu te vīryam dṛśyate rākṣasa adhama
sādhu kṛtvā ātmanaḥ pathyam sādhu mām muñca rāvaṇa
rājya bhraṣṭena dīnena tāpasena gata āyuṣā
anena vidhinā samyak siddhaḥ bhavati tad rasaḥ
dadyāt marica cūrṇena māṣa mātram bhiṣaj varaḥ
śvāsa ucchvāsa yutam ca anyaiḥ mukta jīvana lakṣaṇaiḥ
navajvarāriḥ iti eṣa rasaḥ parama durlabhaḥ
iti iva vilapan rāmaḥ sītā darśana lālasaḥ
vicaran daṇḍaka araṇyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam
hantu kāmam paśum rudram kruddham dakṣa kratau yathā
na alam te vipriyam kartum dīkṣitasya iva sādhavaḥ
śocitum nā arhase vīra yathā anyaḥ prākṛtaḥ tathā
bahūni rakṣasām vāse varṣāṇi vasata sukham
tām diśam dakṣiṇām gatvā śara cāpa asi dhāriṇau
kena kāñjikena sauvīreṇa
rasasya pāradasya doṣāḥ trayaḥ vartante
adhas bhāṇḍe mukham ca tasya bhāṇḍasya uparivartinaḥ
kajjala ābhaḥ yadā sūtaḥ vihāya ghana cāpalam
mṛtaḥ yathā
teṣām madhye viśiṣṭāni ṣoḍaśa ūnam śatam kṛtam
anye eva sūkṣmaśarīram
tava arthe puruṣa vyāghra pampāyāḥ tīra sambhavam
sṛjatām puṣpa varṣāṇi varṣam toyamucām iva
rājānaḥ bahu mitrāḥ ca viśvāsaḥ na atra hi kṣamaḥ
aham ca eva hi rāmaḥ ca sugrīvam śaraṇam gatau
pauruṣam śraya śokasya na antaram dātum arhasi
ye śokam anuvartante na teṣām vidyate sukham
rākṣasasya ca raudrasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
aṅguṣṭha nābhi paryantam adhas bhūmau ca vinyaset
sthitaḥ ayam iti matvā tu praviṣṭaḥ aham durāsadam
tatra rūkṣaḥ laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaḥ calaḥ anilaḥ
snigdhaḥ śītaḥ guruḥ mandaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ
rāmasya śara vegena vismayam paramam gataḥ
sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ rāghavāya kṛta añjaliḥ
api iti niścayena
yācyamānaḥ prayatnena sādhu vākyam kuruṣva me
tasya mālā ca dehaḥ ca marma ghātī ca yaḥ śaraḥ
vidhyanti vimukhān ca api na ca doṣaḥ atra vidyate
gataḥ svām prakṛtim dharmyām dharma dṛṣṭena vartmanā
mama prāṇaiḥ priyataram putram putram iva aurasam
lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tāraḥ saṃbhrānta mānasaḥ
ājagmuḥ udakam kartum nadīm śīta jalām śubhām
ādhāra bhede deveśa sādhakaḥ phala bhāj bhavet
śubhaiḥ vṛṣabha śṛṅgaiḥ ca kalaśaiḥ ca api kāñcanaiḥ
hemni viśeṣaḥ
tāre api viśeṣaḥ
upakāreṇa vīraḥ hi pratikāreṇa yujyate
kulasya ketuḥ sphītasya dīrgha bandhuḥ ca rāghavaḥ
kṛpām na kurute rājā sugrīvaḥ mayi lakṣmaṇa
draṣṭum icchanti cāpasya rūpam vidyut gaṇa upamam
purovāta ātapa rajaḥ tuṣāra paruṣa anilān
nasyam niṣṭhīvanam dhūmam tīkṣṇam vamana recanam
yoni doṣe kaphe vāte śophe kampe ca tat hitam
tvam pramattaḥ na jānīṣe kālam kala vidām vara
pāṇḍura abhra prakāśāni divya mālya yutāni ca
sa tvam grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu saktaḥ mithyā pratiśravaḥ
aja uṣṭra khara meṣāṇām mahiṣasya vasā tathā
na eva akṛtajñaḥ sugrīvaḥ na śaṭhaḥ nā api dāruṇaḥ
na ca roṣa vaśam tāta gantum arhasi lakṣmaṇa
śata koṭi sahasrāṇi laṅkāyām kila rakṣasām
yaḥ te prabhāvaḥ sugrīva yat ca te śaucam uttamam
yat āhuḥ
aṅgāraka samānānām bhīmānām bhīma karmaṇām
grasate tad kṣaṇāt sūtaḥ golakaḥ tu vidhīyate
ṣaṣṭi vāsara jaḥ saḥ ayam jñeyaḥ māsa dvaya udbhavaḥ
gauraḥ nīlaḥ ṣaṣṭikaḥ ayam dvidhā syāt ādyaḥ rucyaḥ śītalaḥ doṣa hārī
priyaṅguḥ madhuraḥ rucyaḥ kaṣāyaḥ svādu śītalaḥ
na aham asmin prabhuḥ kārye vānara īśa na lakṣmaṇaḥ
aṅgada pramukhān vīrān vīraḥ kapi gaṇa īśvaraḥ
janakam dhārakam bhogyam adhyātma ādi tri sādhanam
yatra tiṣṭhati dharma ātmā tapasā svena bhāvitaḥ
harītakyāḥ phale yatra dvayam tat śreṣṭham ucyate
tasya tasya eva vīryeṇa majjānam api nirdiśet
tat ārdram madhuram pāke na ati uṣṇam kaṭukam guru
śukla kandaḥ nakha chedyaḥ medaḥ dhātum iva sravet
uktam puṣkaramūlam tu pauṣkaram puṣkaram ca tat
tad phalam pittalam kuṣṭha kapha anila haram kaṭu
tvām vinā trāṇa kartā ca mama jñāne na vartate
madyam māṃsam tathā amlam ca hitam laśuna sevinām
kapha pitta haraḥ ca eva saraḥ dīpana pācanaḥ
eka deśe api yaḥ dharmaḥ pratītaḥ yasya dharmiṇaḥ
śivabījam mahādeva śiva rūpam na ca anyathā
bahubhyaḥ api hi tantubhyaḥ paṭasya ekasya utpattiḥ dṛṣṭā
kṣveḍantaḥ dhāvamānāḥ ca yayuḥ plavaga sattamāḥ
viveśa vālī tatra api malayam tad jighāṃsayā
sarāṃsi saritaḥ kakṣān ākāśam nagarāṇi ca
vanāni girayaḥ nadyaḥ durgāṇi gahanāni ca
hitam ca eva anukūlam ca kriyatām asya bhāṣitam
vismaya vyagra manasaḥ babhūvuḥ vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
rañjanam ca eva kurute maṇi mūṣa vidhi kramāt
dharma kāmaḥ pitṛvyaḥ te prīti kāmaḥ dṛḍha vrataḥ
paśya sītā apadeśena sākṣāt vaivasvataḥ yamaḥ
śarad saṃvatsaraḥ abdaḥ ca hāyanaḥ vatsaraḥ samāḥ
mama āryaḥ pārthivaḥ pakṣin dhārmikau tasya ca ātmajau
pāradam śivabījam hi tāḍanam na hi kārayet
vainateyāt ca naḥ janma sarveṣām vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
vivakṣā yatna pūrveṇa koṣṭha vyoma guṇa dhvaneḥ
barhiḥ darbhe mayūre ca plakṣa markaṭayoḥ plavaḥ
vali palita vināśam sevitaḥ vīrya vṛddhim sthiram api kurute yaḥ kāminīnām prasaṅgam
eṣa sahasra vedhakaḥ rasaḥ
tayoḥ phalam kaṭu rase pāke ca kaṭukam bhavet
mūlakam laśunam tīkṣṇam śītam uṣṇam ca varjayet
teṣām tu pramāṇam ardha catuṣka muṣṭayaḥ
na agniḥ na toyam na viṣam na śastram na astram eva ca
upadiṣṭāḥ pradeśeṣu teṣām vakṣyāmi vāraṇam
phulla padma upama mukham saumya dṛṣṭim akopanam
tasya pūjā phalam ca eva bhujyate yakṣa rākṣasaiḥ
nirbhayam māninam śūram krodhanam vyavasāyinam
skhalat vācam ca jānīyāt pitṛ graha vaśīkṛtam
